jobs.title: HR & EOR Operations Manager
jobs.description:
HR & EOR Operations Manager

Part-Time | Switzerland (Remote) | Global EOR & HR Platform | Employed via Swiss Entity

ABOUT THE CLIENT

Our client is a fast-growing global HR, payroll, and compliance platform operating across 180+ regions. The company combines technology with owned entities, in-house legal and payroll expertise, transparent pricing, and dedicated human support - helping businesses of all sizes hire talent anywhere in the world.

The company is driven by a constant pursuit of innovation, expanding its product suite to create integrated HR solutions for businesses from fledgling startups to global enterprises.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an HR & EOR Operations Manager to join our Swiss entity on a part-time basis. This is a hands-on operational role - not a purely administrative or advisory position.

As part of the role, you will serve as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under SECO/Zürich personnel leasing law, fulfilling a standing legal obligation tied to our EOR licence. This means you must be genuinely employed, operationally involved, and present in Switzerland - not an external adviser lending a name to a form.

Day-to-day workload is manageable within a 50% FTE, and you will be fully supported by the company's global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome, provided they do not interfere with your availability and supervision of the entity's activities.

This role is a strong fit for HR or EOR professionals already freelancing, holding consulting mandates, or looking to add a substantive part-time role to their portfolio.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Act as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under Swiss personnel leasing (SECO) law.

  • Ensure compliance with Swiss labour-leasing legislation, Swiss employment law, and the staffing industry GAV (minimum wages and equal treatment).

  • Maintain documentation required for SECO and cantonal audits and inspections.

  • Serve as the primary Swiss contact for SECO and cantonal authorities.

  • Oversee HR and employment operations for the Swiss entity - including onboarding, contract controls, and employment matters.

  • Support payroll oversight in collaboration with the global payroll team.

  • Handle employee and client escalations related to HR and compliance matters.

  • Supervise the entity's EOR/personnel leasing activities and ensure they are conducted properly.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Right to Work in Switzerland - one of the following is required:

  • Swiss citizen.

  • EU/EFTA national with a current Swiss B or C permit.

  • Non-EU/EFTA national with a Swiss C permit (a non-EU/EFTA B permit alone does not qualify).

  • EU/EFTA national with a genuine 5-year cross-border G permit.

Education:

Any completed qualification - EFZ apprenticeship, Matura/Abitur, or university degree in any field.

Experience - either route qualifies:

Standard route:

3+ years in one of the following: recruitment or placement, personnel leasing or staffing (including EOR), substantive HR (not admin-only), personnel consulting, or organisational/business consulting. Employment certificates confirming dates, workload percentage and substantive duties are required alongside a CV.

Alternative route:

3+ years of general professional experience plus a completed, recognised HR qualification with a passed exam (e.g. HRSE or VSH HR Assistant). Course attendance without a final certificate does not count.

Character:

Clean criminal record, debt-enforcement register and tax history.

Other:

  • Comfortable being named on the Commercial Register with signing authority.

  • Willing to disclose other jobs, board mandates or licensed-business responsibilities.

  • Genuinely hands-on - purely advisory profiles (external lawyers or accountants with no operational involvement) are not suitable.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a rare opportunity for an experienced HR or EOR professional in Switzerland to take on a meaningful operational role at a global scale without committing to a full-time position.

You will hold a real and recognised legal position within the Swiss entity, with direct contact with SECO and cantonal authorities, while being backed by an experienced international HR, payroll and compliance team.

The 50% structure makes this accessible to consultants, freelancers and professionals looking to add a substantive part-time engagement alongside existing work. International EOR or HR experience is fully valid - experience does not need to be Swiss-based, though familiarity with Swiss employment law and social insurance is an advantage.

The company values a builder mentality - people who want to improve processes, not just maintain them.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

  • Fully remote within Switzerland.

  • Part-time 50% FTE with flexible hours.

  • Direct collaboration with the global HR, payroll and compliance teams.

  • Meaningful presence in Switzerland required (~50% benchmark) - remote-only offshore oversight does not meet regulatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Health insurance contributions.

  • Share incentives.

  • Learning and mentorship opportunities.

  • Team offsites and social events.

  • 4 weeks of work-from-anywhere per year.

  • Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome.

Field Service Engineer (ESS / PV) - France (South)
Your mission

Bonjour et bienvenue à Sungrow! We’re seeking a skilled Field Service Engineer to join our vibrant team in the south part of France.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with project management teams during commissioning and site acceptance phases.

Your profile

You will be joining a team that fosters career advancement, offers attractive compensation and benefits, and operates within an international working environment. jobs.description:
Sales Engineer | EMEIA

At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

This role is offered as remote in Germany. We are only able to accept applications from those based in Germany or who have sponsorship to live and work in Germany. #LI-Remote

What you’ll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work.

As a Sales Engineer, you'll be the technical voice in the room - running demos, answering the hard questions, and helping Key Account Managers and Regional Sales Managers turn opportunities into wins across Public Sector, Healthcare, and Education.

You won't be handed a script. This role comes with real autonomy: you'll decide how to position Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Jamf School and Jamf Mobile Forensics for the customer in front of you, build your own relationships with channel partners, and shape how AI-driven tools fit into the customer experience you're creating. Nobody expects you to be fluent in every product on day one - we're looking for someone who's fluid, curious, and ready to grow into the full portfolio.

You'll join a Sales Engineering team that takes the work seriously and each other less so. Expect a genuinely fun group of people, strong support for your development, and a customer base that makes the work worth doing.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Run live and virtual product demos, tailored to the customer's environment, not a generic script.
  • Become the go-to technical person for your accounts and channel partners - the one people trust to give a straight answer.
  • Recommend Jamf-based solutions that solve real business and technical problems, not just check boxes.
  • Support proof-of-concept projects and trials, seeing them through to a decision.
  • Sit down with channel partners' technical teams to walk through new Jamf products and how to position them well on live opportunities.
  • Take the stage at trade shows, conferences, and industry events to represent Jamf.
  • Run enablement sessions and technical training for partners and internal teams.
  • Team up with marketing to create content - think LinkedIn, YouTube, and webinars - that helps customers understand what's possible.
  • Keep account activity, technical engagement, and sales progress current in the CRM.
  • Bring technical insight to regional sales meetings and help shape strategy, not just execute it.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key regional partners over time.
  • Help teammates stay current by sharing updated technical materials and best practices.

What are we looking for:

  • 3–4 years in sales engineering, technical consultancy, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Fluent in both English and German language
  • Solid grounding in Mobile Device Management, Apple in the enterprise, or network-level cybersecurity - you don't need to know every Jamf product yet, but you should be comfortable learning fast across a broad portfolio.
  • Jamf 300 or 400 certification is a plus.
  • A cybersecurity certification (Cybersecurity Fundamentals or similar) is a plus.
  • The independence to manage a field-based role well, balanced with genuine collaboration - you'll work closely with sales, marketing, product, and global enablement teams.
  • The ability to take a complex technical topic and make it click for whoever's in front of you, whether that's an IT director or a room at a conference.
  • A remote setup with up to 50% travel across EMEIA for customer sites, events, and internal meetings.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We know that big ideas can come from anyone, so we empower everyone to make an impact. Our 90% employee retention rate agrees!
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.
  • Our volunteer time off allows employees to support and give back to our communities.

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

  • Results-focused. Center on professional and personal growth

Smartling is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, skills, and experiences.

*To work from home, you must have a strong internet connection, a quiet space, and a professional (distraction and clutter-free) background.

With 50.000 users and 120.000 devices under management, we’re solving hybrid work challenges like laptop deliveries, returns and equipment tracking, allowing IT teams to focus less on manual hassles and more on strategic initiatives.

Join our team to help shape the future of global collaboration. At Workwize, your work will make a real impact in building smarter, more connected workplaces worldwide.

LinkedIn has also recognized Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands!

Testing and Automation:

Becoming part of Workwize means making an impact. We make sure that we will contribute to the change in the way of working. Entrepreneurs, Operational specialists, Developers, Sales gurus you can find them all at Workwize and are always on the look-out for the next original ideas to reach more consumers and create the best value for our customers.

Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Partner (m/f/x)

Who We Are

At Progyny Global, we are on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide. As part of Progyny Inc., we combine world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology to deliver inclusive, culturally competent support for families everywhere.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Partner to own full-cycle recruitment and help shape the employee experience from offer through the first 180 days. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who enjoys building strong hiring partnerships, creating thoughtful candidate and new hire experiences, and improving how People processes work as the organization grows.

In this role, you’ll go beyond traditional recruiting. You’ll partner closely with hiring managers across teams and regions, guide clear and effective hiring processes, and ensure every candidate and new team member experiences Progyny Global as organized, intentional, and people-centered from the very first interaction.

Reporting to the Senior Lead, Global People & Culture, you’ll have the autonomy to make day-to-day decisions, solve problems, and continuously improve the systems, documentation, and workflows that support hiring and employee lifecycle activities. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to deepen their Talent Acquisition expertise while expanding into broader People Operations in a global environment.

Tasks

Talent Acquisition & Hiring Excellence

  • Own end-to-end recruitment across multiple functions, partnering with hiring managers from intake through offer delivery.
  • Build proactive sourcing strategies and structured, evidence-based hiring processes that support strong decisions and a positive candidate experience.
  • Develop interview guides, assessment frameworks, and practical resources that help hiring managers interview effectively and consistently.
  • Use recruitment data and market insights to improve hiring quality, efficiency, and process consistency.

Employee Lifecycle

  • Own the employee journey from accepted offer through successful completion of the 180-day probation period.
  • Coordinate preboarding, onboarding, and cross-functional handoffs that create an organized and welcoming new hire experience.
  • Partner with managers to support integration, probation milestones, and compliant offboarding activities.

Operational Excellence

  • Simplify, standardize, and improve recruitment and employee lifecycle workflows as the organization grows.
  • Build and maintain documentation, templates, and knowledge resources that support managers and the People team.
  • Use operational data and technology to reduce manual work and strengthen the employee experience.
  • Use AI, automation, and other tools thoughtfully to improve recruiting workflows, reduce manual work, and create a better experience for candidates and hiring teams.

People Operations

  • Develop expertise across core People Operations, including employment documentation, contracts, employee lifecycle administration, and other defined responsibilities.
  • Support day-to-day People Operations with sound judgment, discretion, professionalism, and a strong service mindset.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Talent Partnering, or a comparable recruitment role, ideally with exposure to People Operations or HR administration.
  • Proven ability to manage full-cycle recruitment independently, partner effectively with hiring managers, and guide processes from intake through offer.
  • Experience improving recruitment, interview, onboarding, or employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced or growing organization.
  • Exposure to onboarding, offboarding, employment documentation, contracts, amendments, or employee lifecycle administration, with a strong ability to build expertise where needed.
  • Experience using ATS and HRIS platforms to support accurate, efficient People processes.
  • Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy, discretion, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable working independently, navigating ambiguity, and knowing when to seek support or escalation. ability to interpret data and present insights to clients.
  • Curious about AI and automation, with an interest in exploring practical ways to improve how Talent Acquisition works.

Nice to Have

  • Comfortable supporting international or distributed teams.
  • Track record implementing or optimizing ATS, HRIS, or other People systems.
  • A history of improving operational workflows through automation or technology.
  • Skilled at creating documentation, playbooks, or other operational resources.

Benefits

Why Join Us

Compensation

Total compensation includes a competitive base, annual performance bonus, and equity - so you share directly in Progyny's growth.

  • 💰 Competitive Base Salary: From €55,000 – €65,000 per year, depending on experience.

Account Executive 4

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Account Executive - New Business.

About the job

As a New Business Account Executive, within our Global Sales organization, you will be responsible for prospecting, solution selling and closing new business opportunities across the entire Twilio platform. In this role, you will be directly responsible for becoming an essential strategic partner to some of the largest and fastest growing enterprise companies.You will drive profitable revenue growth by making multi-product selling the default sales motion. This role is highly cross functional, with deep integration with Specialist Sales, Product Management, Field Marketing, Finance, and Solutions Engineering teams.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be responsible for new customer acquisition across the full Twilio portfolio, while being assigned a quota for iACV (incremental Account Contract Value)
  • Own highly analytical and consultative sales cycles to move past transactional vendor relationships and help customers unlock value seamlessly across our portfolio.
  • Ability to multi-thread Enterprise accounts and comfortable building trusted relationships at all levels and acting as a strategic partner to the C-Suite to drive sustained double-digit growth.
  • Work with customers across assigned verticals and regions to understand their business and technical requirements, partnering with the Specialist Sales organization to bring deep technical and domain expertise to complex deals.
  • Collaborate with Product Specialists, Value Engineering, and Enterprise Strategists to incubate new solutions and accelerate the adoption of Twilio platform.
  • Work with teams in Finance, Legal, Pricing, Product, and Operations to design mutually beneficial contracts to address customer requirements, while balancing the needs of our business.
  • Simultaneously execute multiple projects and deals while maintaining high performance across shifting priorities.
  • Partner cross functionally with Specialist Sales, services, product, and GTM Strategy & Operations to develop long-range territory strategies and sales plans.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Twilio’s product and carrier relations teams.
  • Establish yourself as a subject matter expert in the unified communications and data platform industry.
  • Establish yourself as a subject matter expert in the vertical industries you are focused on leveraging deep technical expertise to lead complex, multi-product digital initiatives.
  • Ability to crisply articulate the power of unified GTM organization and how it benefits vertical industry clients by streamlining their strategic relationship with Twilio.
  • Generate and maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

jobs.title: Infrastructure & Security Lead
jobs.description:
Infrastructure & Security Lead

About Luo

 

Luo is one of the fastest-growing FX and cross-border payments companies in Africa. We help African businesses pay their international suppliers faster, more transparently, and more competitively than traditional solutions.

 

After becoming a leading player in a few markets in record time, we are looking to grow our engineering team and keep expanding the financial infrastructure for FX and cross-border payments in Africa.

 

Role overview

 

As Infrastructure & Security Lead, you will join a small team of experienced engineers and be responsible for evolving our cloud infrastructure and its security controls. You will work directly with our CTO to build the foundations that keep LuoPay secure, reliable, and compliant as we scale. The scope covers our GCP infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tooling, as well as the security and compliance program that regulators, partners, and customers depend on.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Analyze our infrastructure and map security risks.

  • Write clear, concise design documents to share infrastructure targets with the rest of the engineering team.

  • Use Terraform to evolve our GCP infrastructure.

  • Use GCP-native security tooling to protect our network, services and databases within GCP.

  • Automate security testing within our delivery pipelines.

  • Research and onboard new tools to improve our reliability and security posture.

  • Work alongside our CTO to implement our security and compliance framework.

 

What we are looking for

  • 10+ years of tech engineering experience

  • Strong experience building cloud infrastructure, managing cloud security and writing Terraform code.

  • Experience within GCP is highly appreciated, though we value fundamental engineering skills over any knowledge of a specific tech stack.

  • Strong appetite for security focused technical work.

  • Wide technical curiosity and willingness to contribute to many different parts of our stack: IAM, networking, governance, CI/CD, observability, APIs and web security.

  • Previous experience working in small, fast-paced teams.

  • Previous experience building cloud infrastructure within a regulated industry is appreciated.

  • Previous experience participating in the implementation of ISO27001 or SOC2 compliance is appreciated.

 

Why join us

  • Play a key role in building the fintech infrastructure that unlocks international payments for businesses in Africa.

  • Work alongside a small team of senior engineers within a fast-paced, growing startup.

  • Be exposed to an an usual breadth of technical responsibilities, with room to grow.

  • Be given the room and support to build a state-of-the art security program in a regulated industry.

  • Continuously experiment with LLMs to expand the boundaries of your impact.

jobs.description:
Engineering Intern / Traineeship

Imagine this. You are helping build the electronic foundation behind advanced aerospace and defence systems, making sure every component, symbol, footprint, and schematic detail is accurate before it reaches hardware.

As an Engineering Intern, you will work hands-on with Altium Designer and support our electronics engineers in creating and maintaining high-quality PCB design data. This is an opportunity to move beyond university projects and work with real engineering hardware where precision and attention to detail matter.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

  • Create, review, and maintain electronic components, schematic symbols, footprints, and library data in Altium Designer
  • Read schematics and component datasheets to ensure design data accurately reflects manufacturer specifications
  • Support engineers with PCB design activities and help maintain clean, consistent, and reliable component libraries
  • Check existing components for errors, inconsistencies, and missing information before they make their way into hardware
  • Help improve library management, component validation, and engineering workflows
  • Use scripting and automation where useful to make repetitive checks faster and more reliable

Requirements

  • Currently studying toward a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field, or recently graduated
  • Hands-on experience with Altium Designer through university projects, personal PCB designs, or previous internships
  • Comfortable with schematic capture, library editors, and creating your own symbols and footprints
  • Ability to read schematics and datasheets, with a solid understanding of packages, pinouts, passive components, and common ICs
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to technical work
  • Good written and spoken English
  • Experience with Altium 365 or another managed library environment is a plus
  • Familiarity with IPC-7351 footprint standards is an advantage
  • Basic Python or similar scripting experience for automation and bulk checks is a plus
  • Exposure to component lifecycle or obsolescence management is an advantage

Who You Are

You are curious, precise, and hands-on. You enjoy getting into the details and understand that a tiny mistake in a component library can become a very real hardware problem later. You work methodically, ask questions when something does not look right, and are excited to learn from experienced engineers while taking real ownership from day one.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer with German
jobs.description:
Customer Success Engineer with German

Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

The ideal candidate will be naturally collaborative, articulate, extremely organized, have a solid technical understanding of Veeam products, and motivated by maximizing customer success and outcomes. Soft skills combined with technical skills are key in this role. As a Customer Success Engineer, you are the primary technical owner driving long-term customer outcomes across the Veeam Data Platform. You’ll lead onboarding, adoption, and optimization; proactively identify churn risk, migrations, and upsell opportunities; and apply deep disaster recovery and resilience (DR&R) expertise to conduct recovery simulations, DRMM assessments, and quarterly resilience reporting for measurable customer value

What You’ll Do

  • Configure customer accounts; customize backup policies and storage; facilitate onboarding; orient stakeholders; walk through admin portals; introduce support channels.
  • Identify migration opportunities; analyze usage and environment; conduct success planning and strategy sessions; align business outcomes with product adoption.
  • Conduct assessments; build protection plans; recommend software products and architectures across the Veeam Data Platform.
  • Run recovery simulations; apply the Veeam Data Resilience Maturity Model (DRMM) to track and report resilience posture; deliver quarterly resilience reports.
  • Monitor signals to detect churn risk early; define mitigation plans; partner on renewal strategy with actionable technical insights.
  • Build business cases; define TCO; articulate value propositions for expansion; schedule checkpoint reviews with stakeholders.
  • Engage CISO/CIO stakeholders with clear risk, status, and opportunity updates; support context for executive discussions and roadmap alignment.
  • Collaborate on marketing-informed campaigns and plays to drive adoption and expansion.
  • Operate with a long-term account assignment model tied to ARR and growth potential, typically covering 5–50 Enterprise and Commercial-Named accounts with $100K+ ARR.
  • Own the technical success plan and adoption roadmap; influence pricing, commercial terms, and renewal terms in partnership with Sales and CS leadership

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years in customer-facing engineering roles focused on data backup and recovery (e.g., Technical Consulting, Pre-Sales SE, Technical Account Manager); this is a mid-level role.
  • Advanced level of English and German language
  • Hands-on expertise across operating systems, virtualization, storage, scripting/automation, cloud platforms, and DR&R best practices.
  • Strong experience designing and executing protection plans, migrations, and recovery simulations; familiarity with Veeam platform capabilities is a plus.
  • VMCE certification required (may be completed post-hire within an agreed timeframe).
  • Preferred industry certifications: AWS Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional), Microsoft Azure Administrator or Solutions Architect Expert
  • Proven ability to translate business outcomes into technical adoption roadmaps and measurable value.
  • Executive stakeholder engagement skills (CISO/CIO) with the ability to synthesize technical, business, and risk signals into clear recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, cross-functional collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

What You’ll Get

jobs.description:
Working Student Modeled Data

At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Our Mission

As AI rapidly transforms how information is created and consumed, high-quality proprietary data is becoming the critical ingredient for generating trustworthy insights and enabling better decisions. Models become more powerful as the quality of the underlying data improves.

The mission of the Modeled Data department is to develop high-quality proprietary data at scale, empowering our customers to make better business decisions with confidence.

To achieve this, we are building the next generation of proprietary data production: a standardized, AI-enabled production system that combines artificial intelligence and human expertise to deliver scalable, transparent, and high-quality outputs.

We believe the future is not AI instead of analysts, but AI together with analysts. AI excels at automating repetitive work, scaling production, and accelerating execution, while analysts contribute structured problem solving, statistical reasoning, domain expertise, and critical judgment. Together, they create outcomes that neither could achieve alone.

Our analysts therefore have a dual mission: they continuously deepen their expertise in business domains and statistical modeling while simultaneously helping build and improve the AI-powered production platform that will define the future of proprietary data.

 
 

Your Role

As a Working Student, you will support our analysts in building and maintaining proprietary data and contribute to improving our analytical workflows and production systems.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Support the analysis of structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources

  • Assist in collecting, cleaning, and preparing datasets for modeling and analysis

  • Help build and maintain Python-based analytical workflows and scripts

  • Support analysts in identifying trends, patterns, and key market insights

  • Assist in improving data pipelines, methodologies, and documentation

  • Contribute to ongoing projects that aim to make our data production more scalable and efficient

 
 

Your Profile

  • Enrolled student at a university (mandatory)

  • Field of study in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline (preferred)

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills

  • Basic experience with Python (e.g., through coursework, projects, or internships)

  • Interest in data, markets, and business dynamics

  • Ability to work independently and in a structured way

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills (English required, German is a plus)

 

Nice to have

  • Experience with SQL or databases

  • Familiarity with data analysis or visualization tools

  • Exposure to statistical methods or market research

  • Interest in AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot)

 
 

Your Team

You will be part of an international, data-driven team working on analytical projects across different markets and industries. You will support real modeling and data production work while gaining hands-on experience with data, tools, and methodologies.

 

This role offers the opportunity to learn how proprietary data is built at scale and how analytical workflows can be combined with AI to create scalable data products.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

Principal Engineer (Payments)

About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// We’re looking for a Principal Engineer - Payments to join Masabi’s Architecture team, with a primary focus on our payments domain.

This is a senior role for someone who combines strong technical judgement with deep payments experience. You’ll shape the technical direction of our payments platform while staying close enough to the detail to design, review and support meaningful technical work.

Working across the engineering organisation, you’ll act as a senior technical leader within the payments domain: contributing to architecture, guiding complex decisions and helping teams build scalable, resilient systems that support millions of journeys worldwide.

The role suits someone who can move between system-level thinking and implementation, who understands trade-offs, can navigate ambiguity and helps turn complex or loosely defined problems into clear, practical technical approaches.

Location_

  • Shape the technical direction of Masabi’s payments platform, contributing to architecture, standards and engineering best practices

  • Design and deliver scalable, secure, resilient and cost-effective payment solutions aligned with Masabi’s platform direction

  • Familiarity with a range of tools and technologies including:

Bringing ML research into application

dida builds custom machine learning software for industrial and enterprise clients, among them Siemens, Deutsche Bahn, idealo, klöckner.i and Enpal, and has received the Microsoft “AI for Earth Award” for innovative environmental projects, among other recognitions. Our team combines scientific excellence with real business requirements.

Many of our projects start with a concept or evaluation workshop: together with the decision makers we assess use cases and the data situation and turn vague ideas into a concrete project roadmap. We are currently building this workshop format into a consulting offering of its own, and we are looking for reinforcement.

Your role: strategic and technical consulting

As an AI Consultant you are the bridge between our ML scientists and the business units of our clients. You work in tandem with the Account Management and Business Development team and take the technical lead in workshops and pre-sales meetings.

In this position you are the face of dida for specific industries: you follow no rigid process, but develop innovative solutions together with our engineers and our clients.

Your tasks

  • Prepare and run workshops: You prepare client workshops and run them together with the team. Your part is the technical depth: assessing use cases, reviewing the data situation, judging feasibility and translating complex ML concepts into clear business cases.
  • Turn results into roadmaps: You translate workshop results into technical roadmaps and work with our ML teams on effort estimates and proposal content.
  • Work hands-on: You look at client data yourself and build clickable prototypes and small demos that make workshop results tangible right away.
  • Support business development: You bring in technical expertise, for example in discovery calls or on feasibility questions. Commercial responsibility for accounts, offers, pricing and negotiations stays with the sales team.
  • Develop our standards: You extend our workshop frameworks and templates that we reuse with every new client.


Your Profile

  • Education: A strong degree in a quantitative field, for example data science, computer science, mathematics, physics or engineering.
  • Consulting experience: Ideally 2 to 5 years. Big firm or boutique matters less than having worked on projects directly at the client. Exposure to several industries is a plus.
  • Data science and coding: You understand how ML models work and know your way around databases. Practical data science experience and solid coding skills, above all in Python, are a plus.
  • Hands-on mentality: You try things out directly and enjoy building a first prototype quickly.

  • Languages: Business-fluent German for the DACH market and fluent English for our internal communication.

Even if you do not tick every box: we look forward to your application.


Why us?

  • Short paths: Direct collaboration with the management team.
  • Location: Berlin. Frankfurt am Main is possible by arrangement, many of our clients are based in southern and south-western Germany.


What we need from you?

Please include with your application:

  • CV (required)

Specialist, Workplace Experience

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Our mission is to enable businesses and their communities to thrive in the digital economy. We’re the strategic payments partner for some of the best known fast-moving brands globally such as Wise, Hut Group, Sony Electronics, Homebase, Henkel, Klarna and many others. Purpose-built with performance and scalability in mind, our flexible cloud-based payments platform helps global enterprises launch new products and create experiences customers love. And it's not just what we build that makes us different. It's how.

We empower passionate problem-solvers to collaborate, innovate and do their best work. That’s why we’re on the Forbes Cloud 100 list and a Great Place to Work accredited company. And we’re just getting started. We’re building diverse and inclusive teams around the world — because that’s how we create even better experiences for our merchants and our partners.

Role overview | Context

In this role, you will play a key part in delivering, optimising, and continuously evolving the London office experience across our UK operations.

You will own critical operational areas, driving performance through data and ensuring the workplace operates with precision, accountability, and consistency. Acting as a link between strategy and execution, you will translate workplace priorities into scalable processes, measurable outcomes, and high quality day to day experiences.

You will take ownership across workplace operations, vendor management, reporting, and governance, with the autonomy to make decisions and lead on key initiatives.

This is a high impact role suited to someone who thrives in fast paced environments, brings a strong analytical mindset, and is motivated by raising the bar for workplace experience and operational excellence.

You will take a customer first approach to every interaction, proactively understanding employee and visitor needs, resolving issues through to completion, and using insight and data to continuously improve the workplace experience.


Role overview | Remit and Responsibilities

Amongst other duties, this role will be primarily responsible for the below.

Operational Leadership & Delivery

  • Own day to day workplace operations, ensuring the office runs smoothly, safely, and consistently while delivering a seamless employee and visitor experience.

  • Act as a visible and trusted on site point of contact, ensuring workplace spaces, services, and touchpoints are well maintained, well stocked, and delivered to a high standard.

  • Conduct regular workplace walkthroughs to identify, resolve, and escalate issues before they affect employees or visitors, maintaining consistently high standards across presentation, safety, functionality, and hospitality.

  • Drive operational excellence through strong execution, accountability, and continuous improvement across all Workplace activities.

  • Lead and support workplace initiatives, aligning delivery with Workplace strategy, business needs, and opportunities to enhance the day to day employee experience and operational efficiency.

Financial Management

  • Own the UK Workplace budget end to end, including tracking, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost optimisation

  • Lead procurement, PO management, and invoicing processes with accuracy and efficiency

  • Partner with Finance and Accounts Payable to resolve issues and improve processes

  • Manage vendor commercials, including pricing negotiations and contract renewals

Vendor & Contract Management

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with key vendors and site partners, including building management, cleaning and maintenance providers, acting as the primary point of contact for day-to-day operational matters.

  • Proactively manage supplier communication, ensuring expectations are clear, issues are resolved promptly, and services are delivered consistently to agreed standards.

  • Drive day to day vendor performance by monitoring service levels, holding suppliers accountable, providing regular feedback, and escalating risks or recurring issues where appropriate.

  • Support contract management by maintaining accurate supplier records, tracking key dates and renewals, and coordinating contract administration.

  • Identify opportunities to improve supplier performance, service delivery, and operational efficiency through regular reviews, performance reporting, and ongoing collaboration.

Data, Reporting & Performance

  • Own Workplace reporting frameworks, dashboards, and KPI tracking

  • Deliver monthly and quarterly reporting across budget, operations, and workplace experience metrics

  • Combine operational data, service usage, employee feedback, and qualitative insight to identify trends, prioritise improvements, and measure the impact of changes on the employee experience.

  • Track service performance measures including employee satisfaction, response and resolution times, service usage, recurring issues, and supplier performance; communicate outcomes and actions clearly to stakeholders.

  • Ensure team accountability to reporting standards and performance metrics

Stakeholder & Site Operations

  • Supporting engagement with building management (e.g. CBRE), ensuring issue tracking, resolution, and accountability

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships across People, Finance, and wider business teams including senior leadership

Compliance & Sustainability

  • Own Workplace compliance and reporting obligations (e.g. SECR, ESOS, energy reporting)

  • Ensure alignment with regulatory, environmental, and company standards

  • Drive improvements in sustainability performance

Workplace Experience & Projects

  • Oversee experience led services (e.g. Food & Beverage), ensuring quality, consistency, and cost control

  • Partner with Workplace Coordinator(s) to deliver an exceptional day to day employee experience

  • Lead Workplace projects end to end and implement scalable process improvements

  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance workplace experience and operational efficiency

  • Build a sense of community through thoughtful workplace activations, local events, welcome moments, and connection opportunities that respond to employee needs and reinforce Checkout’s culture.

  • Gather employee feedback through regular informal engagement, surveys, and service touchpoints, ensuring concerns are acknowledged, resolved, and closed out with clear communication.

Requirements:

  • Experience in a workplace, operations, or culture experience role, ideally within a fast paced environment

  • A customer first, hospitality minded approach, with the ability to build trusted relationships and create positive, personalised employee and visitor experiences.

  • Proven ability to own and manage operational functions, not just support them

  • Strong financial acumen, with experience in budget management, forecasting, and cost control

  • Confidence coordinating suppliers across hard and soft facilities management, responding to building issues, and escalating technical or compliance matters appropriately.

  • Experience managing vendors and contracts, with a strong understanding of SLAs and performance management

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is on a mission to transform the $350 billion global jewelry industry. We're building the operating system for the industry — a marketplace that connects diamond and gemstone suppliers directly with retailers, giving both sides a faster, more transparent, and more efficient way to trade. Today, Nivoda processes over $300M in annual transactions and continues to grow at an extraordinary pace, with teams based in London, New York, Hong Kong, Mumbai, and beyond.

 

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

 

About the Role 🤔

We're looking for a highly proactive, operationally sharp, people-first Operations Manager to lead fulfilment performance at our UK hub. You'll set clear expectations, enforce standards, and drive accountability across intake, QC, shipping, and returns while building strong relationships with key suppliers, partners, and carriers.

This is a hands-on, full-accountability role: you'll own performance and culture within the hub, build on an already-established foundation, and mentor a dynamic, fast-growing team. It bridges execution with team development, and calls for strong operational judgment, structured thinking, and comfort in a fast-evolving, high-growth environment.

What will you be doing? 😎

Own UK Hub Logistics & Fulfilment Performance

  • Take full ownership of fulfilment operational KPIs across the UK hub: speed, accuracy, and service levels

  • Own end-to-end performance across intake, QC, shipping, and returns, ensuring adherence to service-level commitments

  • Drive daily execution across the team while maintaining a strong focus on scalability and process robustness

  • Review weekly operational metrics by function (intake, QC, shipping, returns, express) and implement improvements

  • Maintain strong local relationships with suppliers, runners, carriers, and other local partners

Build & Scale New Workflows

  • Lead the rollout and optimisation of new & existing fulfilment streams for UK

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements to increase throughput and reduce errors

Lead & Develop the Team

  • Run regular team check-ins and structured performance conversations, setting clear expectations and giving direct feedback

  • Cultivate a team culture rooted in accountability, precision, clarity, and growth

Cross-Functional & Cross-Hub Ownership

  • Act as the primary interface between UK fulfilment, customer support, supplier teams, and global stakeholders

  • Partner with other Nivoda hubs for cross-hub alignment and contribute insights in WBRs

What do we need from you? 💪

  • 6 - 8 years in operations, fulfillment, logistics-based office management or within the diamond, gemstone, or luxury goods industry

  • Extensive experience directly managing people or leading teams

  • Demonstrated ability to execute and enforce daily operational workflows

  • Clear, effective communication skills and a highly organised approach

  • Desire and ability to work in a fast-growing company where processes change continuously

Nice to have ✨

  • Proficiency in Excel/Sheets

  • GIA or Gem A qualification is highly desirable

  • Prior exposure to or experience in diamond or gemstone quality control is also highly desirable.

     

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

Electrical Engineer (Tooling)

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Overview

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

  • Component selection and BOM management

  • Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.

  • PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.

  • Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.

  • Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.

  • Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.

  • Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.

  • EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.

  • Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.

  • Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.

  • Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Legal Counsel – Commercial Contracts

ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

Location: Hybrid from Paris or full remote

Role Overview

ScorePlay signs deals with some of the biggest organizations in sports, and every one of them starts with a contract. We are hiring a Commercial Contracts Counsel to own that: redlines, negotiations, signatures, the whole thing. You work directly with Lou, our General Counsel, and are the first point of contact for Sales on contracts.

What you will do

1. Contracts

  • You review, redline and negotiate the agreements that close our deals: MSAs, service agreements, order forms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs, with clubs, leagues, federations, broadcasters and brands, often across several countries.

  • Sales comes to you when a deal is stuck on terms, and your job is to unstick it: fast turnaround, pragmatic fallbacks, and the judgement to know when a point is worth holding.

  • You partner with Sales, Finance, RevOps and Customer Success so contract terms match how the deal is actually priced, booked and delivered.

  • You take a share of vendor and partner agreements alongside Lou, split based on what is moving and where you want to build depth.

2. Tools, processes and enablement

  • We use AI heavily in contract work: drafting, first-pass reviews, summarizing counterparty terms. We want someone who genuinely enjoys this and keeps looking for a smarter way to handle the repetitive part.

  • Our legal playbook is young. You execute it, then you help Lou refine it with what you see in real negotiations.

3. Privacy and security

  • You contribute to customer security, privacy and vendor due-diligence questionnaires, and to DPA and international transfer questions. The heart of the role is contracts, with room to grow into broader compliance work if that interests you.

What we are looking for

  • You know commercial contracts inside out. 3 to 5 years of experience, most of it in-house, with contracts at the core of what you did.

  • You work autonomously. Give you an MSA or a set of customer redlines and you come back with a position, a fallback and a recommendation.

  • You ship fast. A solid answer today beats a perfect one on Friday, and you're comfortable making the call at 80% certainty.

  • You're resourceful. When something is unclear, you dig, you ask, you find a way, rather than waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You like helping people win. Supporting a Sales team means being responsive, available, and genuinely happy when a deal signs because of your work.

  • You're excited by AI. You already use it in your legal work, or you can't wait to, and you keep looking for smarter ways to handle the repetitive parts.

What’s fun about this role

  • You negotiate international contracts with some of the biggest names in sports: clubs, leagues, federations and broadcasters on every continent.

  • As our first commercial counsel, you own your function and you're the main partner of the Sales team on both sides of the Atlantic.

  • You sit in sales calls with senior stakeholders at major sports organizations, on deals worth USD 50k to 500k a year. When a deal closes, you're usually one of the key players who made it work.

  • Small team, short loops. You'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to the table, build playbooks, experiment with AI and new tools, and learn a ton along the way.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Director – EMEA
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Director – EMEA

MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Location: UK, remote
Travel: Regular travel across EMEA required
Reports to: Sr. Director of Sales, EMEA

The Role

MaintainX is expanding its enterprise presence across EMEA, and we’re rapidly expanding our sales team focused on the UK & Ireland market, with the potential to expand your territory to the rest of Europe Middle East and Africa depending on experience

This is a new-logo sales role for someone who knows how to build pipeline, create urgency with complex industrial buyers, and close multi-site enterprise deals. You’ll work closely with our EMEA sales leadership to establish the regional motion, win early reference customers, and help shape how MaintainX goes to market across the region.

This is not an account-management seat. We’re looking for a senior hunter who is energized by building territory from the ground up, selling into operational environments, and turning unfamiliar accounts into long-term strategic customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Own new-logo enterprise growth across a UK&I-led EMEA territory, closing complex, multi-site deals from first conversation through signature.

  • Build and manage your own pipeline through targeted prospecting, executive outreach, partner signals, and coordinated campaigns with BDR and Marketing.

  • Sell to operational and executive buyers — including COOs, VP Operations, Reliability, Engineering, and Maintenance leaders — using the language of uptime, OEE, MTTR, safety, and asset performance.

  • Lead full-cycle enterprise sales motions, including discovery, business-case development, multi-threading, stakeholder alignment, procurement, negotiation, and close.

  • Build territory plans that prioritize the right accounts, industries, and expansion opportunities across the region.

  • Navigate 6–12+ stakeholder buying committees and maintain disciplined forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and mutual action plans.

  • Bring market feedback back to Product, Marketing, and GTM leadership to help sharpen how MaintainX wins in EMEA.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of enterprise B2B software closing experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle sales into large, complex organizations.

  • Experience selling €250K–€1M+ ACV deals, ideally across multi-site or operationally complex environments.

  • Proven hunter DNA: you have personally sourced, developed, and closed cold enterprise accounts rather than relying primarily on inbound demand or an established regional brand.

  • Experience selling into manufacturing, industrials, energy, utilities, facilities, logistics, or other asset-intensive environments.

  • Comfort building a territory from an early stage — whether in a new region, startup environment, new product category, or underdeveloped market.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to create credibility quickly with operational leaders and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Multi-country EMEA sales experience, with an understanding of how buying processes, procurement, and decision-making differ across markets.

  • High discipline around pipeline management, forecasting, account strategy, and deal execution.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in CMMS, EAM, APM, IoT, industrial SaaS, field operations, or maintenance/reliability software.

  • Familiarity with platforms such as Maximo, SAP PM, Hexagon, IFS/Ultimo, or adjacent industrial software ecosystems.

  • Experience at a Series C/D, pre-IPO, or high-growth SaaS company.

  • Fluency in another European language, especially German, French, Dutch, or Spanish.

Why MaintainX

  • We’re backed by $254M in total funding, including a $150M Series D in 2025, with a $2.5B valuation and investors including Bessemer Venture Partners and Bain Capital Ventures.

  • We’re recognized as the #1 EAM/CMMS platform on G2, a Forbes Cloud 100 company, and a Verdantix Green Quadrant CMMS leader.

  • We’re solving a real, urgent problem: industrial teams are still losing time to paper, spreadsheets, legacy systems, and reactive maintenance. MaintainX helps them improve reliability where it matters most — on the floor.

  • You’ll join at a meaningful inflection point: strong global traction, early EMEA expansion, and the opportunity to help define the enterprise motion in-region.

  • We offer a competitive package, meaningful equity, and the chance to help build a category-defining company.

What’s in it for you:

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity opportunities.

  • Healthcare, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Take what you need PTO.

  • A Work Culture where:

    • You’ll work alongside folks across the globe that reflect the MaintainX values, Smart Humble Optimist.

    • We believe in meritocracy, where ideas and effort are publicly celebrated.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

Full-Time UK

jobs.title: Growth Manager - Campaigns
jobs.description:
Growth Manager - Campaigns

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the role

You will own the EEA growth campaign engine, which mainly comprises of 4 types: Affiliate, Listing, Trade & Earn, and New Product Launches. This is both a coordination and execution role. You will be the single accountable owner who turns a campaign concept into a shipped, measured, and reflected-upon outcome by orchestrating creative, media, lifecycle, BD, KOL ops, product marketing, and legal. The number on the campaign is yours. You drive the outcome.


What you will own

  1. Affiliate campaigns: Activation pulses on top of the always-on affiliate channel. Coordinated with BD and BD Operations.

  2. Listing campaigns: New token listing campaigns shipped within 24 hours of listing decisions. Tight loop with Listing PM, legal, comms, BD/KOL Ops, exchange ops.

  3. Trade & Earn campaigns: Volume incentives, leaderboards, zero fee promos. Built around clear unit economics and incrementality, not vanity volume.

  4. Launch campaigns: Product and feature launches. Coordinated with product marketing, product team, social team, and lifecycle team.

What you will do

  1. Translate fuzzy stakeholder asks into clear campaign briefs that creative, paid, and lifecycle can act on without a six-revision loop.

  2. Build and own campaign plans with clear gates, dependencies, owners, and dates. Hold stakeholders accountable when slots slip.

  3. Define success metrics with analytics before launch, not after. Run holdouts where possible. Run reflection sessions within 7 days of campaign close. Publish learnings the team can reuse.

  4. Navigate MiCA and MiFID II constraints with legal. You will not be the lawyer, but you will know enough to flag the risks early and propose alternatives.

  5. Be the connective tissue between EEA Growth and Global Campaigns. Localise global playbooks to EEA markets. Push EEA-originated wins back to global for global execution.

What we are looking for

Must-haves:

  • Four to seven years total experience, two-plus years coordinating end-to-end campaigns at a tier 1 regulated crypto exchange (Binance, Kraken, Bitpanda, Coinbase, or similar). You have shipped at least 10 campaigns with named numbers attached. And you have the receipts.

  • Fluency in English and German, French, or Dutch.

  • Hands-on familiarity with EEA regulator dynamics under MiCA and MiFID II. You have shipped campaigns under regulator review and lived to tell the tales.

  • Strong brief-writing muscle. Strong project management muscle with strong stakeholder management across senior and peer levels.

  • Analytical literacy: you can read a campaign dashboard, spot the wrong attribution, ask the right question of analytics, and present results to leadership.

  • Budget discipline. You understand CAC payback, ROAS, incremental volume, LTV.

Who you are

  • Competitive. You want your campaign on the leaderboard against Global. You want EEA to outperform.

  • Crypto-native. You trade. You have a wallet. You know which tokens listed last week and which exchange ran the best campaign around it. You have opinions.

  • Detail-oriented. You catch the wrong token contract address in a launch comms draft before legal does.

  • Fast. The good campaigns ship within hours of the news, not days.

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.
