Customs Specialist (Europe)
jobs.description:
Customs Specialist (Europe)

Location: Fully remote in Europe

Working Hours: Mon - Fri, 9AM - 6PM

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our Mission 🎯

Nivoda started with a simple observation: buying and selling diamonds was slow, opaque, and inefficient, no matter how big or small your business was. Our platform fixes this by giving every jewellery business, wherever they are in the world, the same access to inventory, financing, and logistics as the biggest players in the industry.

About the Role 🤔

As we expand into jewellery and new markets, the complexity of moving products across borders has grown fast. Loose diamonds have historically had simple customs treatment in most jurisdictions; jewellery is a different story, with its own tariff regimes and duty rules. This is a new, dedicated role that will sit within fulfilment, close to the shipments and the broker relationships where trade compliance actually gets executed day to day preparing documentation, applying classifications, managing broker performance, and owning our duty drawback program end to end. Legal & Compliance own the policy layer: the classification framework, country-of-origin rules, and regulatory interpretation. You'll partner with them constantly and escalate anything genuinely unclear, but this role owns execution.

It's an individual contributor role with high ownership; there's no capability like this at Nivoda today, so you'll be building the operating rhythm as you go, not inheriting one.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Prepare all shipment documentation and commercial invoices, and ensure accurate, complete documentation is retrieved from brokers and carriers and stored centrally on our platform

  • Apply the HTS classifications and country-of-origin determinations that Legal & Compliance have approved, consistently across our shipment processes and systems in partnership with product

  • Manage day-to-day customs broker relationships, coordinating clearance, reviewing broker performance, and ensuring broker practices stay aligned with our classification framework

  • Monitor duties as part of landed shipping costs, catch unexpected duty outcomes, and file claims with customs brokers when errors are found

  • Resolve routine customs queries during clearance, and ensure declarations for import and export are applied accurately

  • Own the duty drawback program day to day, acting as the internal point of contact with Livingstone, and preparing and validating claims before submission

  • Monitor the US import bond and keep it compliant, since this underpins business continuity for our largest lane

  • Partnering with our manufacturers (starting with India) to ensure their export documentation and processes support compliant, duty-efficient shipping

  • Identifying and acting on duty-saving opportunities through relevant free trade agreements (e.g. India-UK, EU-UK, EU-India, UAE-India)

  • Building out trade compliance processes as our jewellery business scales into new duty-liable markets, and escalating complex classification or legal interpretation questions to Legal & Compliance

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Proven experience in global trade compliance or customs operations, with a track record on US, UK, EU import/export specifically

  • Extensive US import-export experience is required.

  • Direct experience managing customs broker relationships and shipment documentation at volume

  • Experience filing duty drawback or tariff reclaim claims

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor with real autonomy

  • Detail-oriented and process-minded: you'll be establishing how this works at Nivoda, not just following an existing playbook

  • Based in the EU or UK, with the flexibility to work across time zones as we scale globally

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, coordinating external brokers/carriers/manufacturers and internal Legal, Fulfilment, and Ops teams

  • A commercial mindset, you connect compliance work back to cost savings and business impact

Nice to have ✨

  • Experience with free trade agreements and preferential duty schemes (e.g. India–UK, EU–UK, EU–India, UAE–India)

  • Experience in jewellery, diamonds, gemstones, or other high-value/luxury goods logistics

  • Experience with Indian export processes

  • Background in a fast-scaling, international e-commerce or marketplace business

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

Our current benefits

🕰️ Flexible working and a vibrant company culture

💻 Remote work

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

Not quite the right fit?

If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we'd encourage you to join our Nivoda Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

About The Role

The ML Infrastructure team builds and operates the shared backend services and platform capabilities that Constructor's ML and product teams rely on to develop, deploy, and run machine learning at scale - from model serving (including LLMs) to the specialized storages and data pipelines behind it.

We are a service team by nature: our roadmap is shaped by the needs of product teams, and we succeed when they can move faster with less friction. We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is comfortable with, and motivated by this dynamic, and who will take end-to-end ownership of core services.

In the near and mid-term, our focus areas include:

  • Making ML workloads easy to run, scale, and operate for every team

  • Providing self-service, configurable infrastructure components to ML and product teams

  • Owning and evolving core ML services and related pipelines with a high bar for reliability and performance

Challenges you will tackle

  • Design, build, and operate high-load distributed backend services that power the company's ML infrastructure

  • Take end-to-end ownership of core ML services and related data pipelines: from design and implementation to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement

  • Partner with ML and product teams to understand their needs and turn them into reliable, reusable platform capabilities

  • Make and defend technical decisions: evaluate trade-offs, design first, and own the outcome

  • Be responsible for what you and your team do

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in backend or platform engineering

  • Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language)

  • Hands-on experience developing on a public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or with self-managed Kubernetes - AWS is our primary platform, but we're not limited to it

  • Experience designing and building distributed, high-load services and APIs

  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and their trade-offs

  • Design-driven engineering mindset: we're a coding-assistant-friendly environment and expect you to use modern AI tools - but you lead with system design and a strong understanding of their applicability and trade-offs

  • Ownership and proactivity: you can't close your eyes to problems, but are ready to solve them and take responsibility for outcomes

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Rust (or C/C++/Go) - a strong plus

  • Experience developing or contributing to ML platforms or ML infrastructure - a strong plus

  • Experience setting up and operating any vector database (Qdrant, Milvus, Weaviate, OpenSearch, pgvector, etc.) - a strong plus

  • Experience with model serving / inference infrastructure, including LLMs

Benefits

  • 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

  • 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Full Stack
jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist, Full Stack

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you'll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily.

As a Senior Data Scientist, Attribution, you will be embedded within a specific risk category (e.g., Sanctions, Cybercrime, Counter Terrorism) and own the attribution algorithms that drive direct customer outcomes — from seizing illicit funds to disrupting crypto-enabled crime networks. You'll operate as equal parts Subject Matter Expert and Data Scientist, translating deep domain knowledge into production-grade intelligence.

The impact you'll have here:

  • Own end-to-end attribution for a risk category: identify high-impact targets, build algorithms (heuristics, ML models, AI agents), and ship to production.

  • Collaborate tightly with — and become — a Subject Matter Expert for your category, translating customer and GTM needs into actionable intelligence.

  • Navigate all intelligence layers (Network / On-chain / Protocol) to uncover patterns competitors can't replicate.

  • Ship production-quality code — heuristics, ML models, and data pipelines — with rigorous evaluation and scalable architecture.

  • Drive measurable outcomes: billions in illicit funds traced, seized, or prevented.

What we’re looking for:

  • Quantitative background (Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, Physics).

  • Strong problem-solving mindset: gets to the root cause, leverages creativity, and thrives in ambiguity with a hypothesis-driven, iterative approach.

  • Demonstrated domain curiosity — ability to absorb and apply expertise in blockchain, fraud, money laundering, or cybercrime.

  • 6+ years in an analytical role with strong SQL, Python, and AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code).

  • Experience with distributed data systems (Spark, BigQuery, Airflow) and shipping production code.

  • Strong async communication (Loom, Slack, Notion) and ability to own work independently in a remote environment.

  • Bonus: Deep ML experience, prior work in crypto, financial crime, or financial institutions.

About the Team:

  • Data Scientists are embedded within risk categories teams (Sanctions, Cybercrime, Nation States, etc.), working closely with SMEs, engineers, and cross-functional partners.

  • Fully remote and globally distributed. Most overlap occurs 7am–12pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • All team members must have at least 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

  • On-call responsibilities: Analytics on-call (< 1 hr/day monthly) and Data Science on-call (1-2 hrs/day every 3 months).

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Rapid Customer Impact. Deliver last-minute, high-stakes projects for key customers — turning around attribution insights in days, not weeks.

  • MVP to Production. Build complex algorithms with tight timeframes (1-2 sprints for MVP) and iterate based on real customer feedback.

  • Parallel Execution. Juggle multiple priorities across categories and stakeholders while maintaining quality and speed.

About TRM's Engineering Levels:

Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decision decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance. Provides mentorship to junior engineers, and enhances operational excellence through tech debt reduction and knowledge sharing.

Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up. Consistently delivers efficient and reusable systems, optimizes team throughput with appropriate tradeoffs, mentors team members, and enhances cross-team collaboration through documentation and knowledge sharing.

Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams. Partners with stakeholders to set the team vision and technical roadmaps for one or more products. Is a role model and mentor to the entire engineering organization. Ensures system health and quality with operational reviews, testing strategies, and monitoring rigor.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $210,000

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Mendix is the leading low-code agentic enterprise platform. Our customers use Mendix to create and deploy better software for the enterprise, faster. Mendix enables collaboration between business users and developers to work together throughout the development process. Our group is responsible for driving innovation within Mendix as we work on modern technologies crucial to develop and deliver an Agentic Enterprise Platform to our customers. Our local team in Munich develops Agents Kit, the Mendix agent building SDK, so our customers can intuitively develop agents and agentic applications with an engaging end-user experience. jobs.title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d)

Deine Mission

Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster mit einer KI-gestützten Software für die Entscheidungsgrundlage der Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bauträger, Banken und Investoren nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025.

Wir wachsen weiter – und um dieses Wachstum zu tragen, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) deutschlandweit mit regelmäßigen Office Besuchen in Münster oder Berlin.

Du verantwortest unser IT-Management & die Administration und baust die Systemlandschaft, mit der unser Team arbeitet – von Geräten und Zugängen bis zu nachweisbaren Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards gegenüber unseren Enterprise-Kunden und Investoren. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du die Revenue Operations bei der Administration des zentralen CRM Systems, indem du Prozesse automatisierst und eine verlässliche Datenbasis schaffst.

IT-Infrastruktur & Device Management* Du baust unser Apple-Setup von Grund auf neu auf – Enrollment, Blueprints und Konfigurationsprofile über Apple Business, sauber migriert und dauerhaft gepflegt

  • Du setzt einen verbindlichen Security-Baseline-Standard durch – Verschlüsselung, Update-Policies, kontrollierte Endgeräte – und hältst ihn nachweisbar
  • Du verantwortest den Hardware-Lifecycle end to end und planst den Gerätebedarf entlang unseres Hiring-Plans

Identity & Access* Du gestaltest, wie Zugriffe bei syte vergeben, geändert und wieder entzogen werden – gruppenbasiert, dokumentiert und ohne Lücken beim Offboarding

  • Du entwickelst Google Workspace als Identity Provider weiter und bringst SSO überall dorthin, wo die Plattform es hergibt
  • Du bringst Struktur in unsere SaaS-Landschaft: Lizenzen, Rollen, Berechtigungen – und die Tools, die bisher niemand freigegeben hat

Security & Compliance* Du machst uns gegenüber Enterprise-Kunden auskunftsfähig: Kontrollregister, Security-Fragebögen, Nachweise auf Knopfdruck

  • Du entscheidest unternehmerisch, welches Risiko wir bewusst akzeptieren und welches wir schließen
  • Du dokumentierst deine Prozesse in Runbooks, um eine klare Knowledge Base zu bauen

Revenue Operations* Du verantwortest unser HubSpot-Setup als zentrale Revenue-Plattform und entwickelst es weiter – Pipelines, Lifecycle Stages, Workflows und Reporting

  • Du identifizierst manuelle Abläufe und automatisierst sie systematisch

Dein Profil

  • Hintergrund in B2B-Tech/SaaS: Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in IT-Administration, Internal IT oder Systemadministration mit – vorzugsweise in einem wachsenden Tech/SaaS Startup.
  • Apple Affinität: Du bringst eine Affinität für macOS und iOS mit oder hast eine hohe Bereitschaft, dich schnell in die Apple-Administration mit Apple Business und MDM-Profilen einzuarbeiten.
  • Ausgeprägtes Systemverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Geräte, Identitäten und Zugriffe zusammenhängen, und arbeitest strukturiert statt reaktiv.
  • Plattform-Tiefe: Du beherrschst Google Workspace aus der Admin-Perspektive und willst unseren Revenue Stack ebenso gründlich lernen.
  • Automatisierung: Du kommst mit APIs und kleinen Skripten zurecht und erkennst, was sich automatisieren lässt – ob über n8n, HubSpot-Workflows oder ein paar Zeilen Code.
  • Pragmatismus: Du kannst begründen, welches Risiko wir bewusst tragen und welches wir schließen – und erklärst eine Einschränkung so, dass Kolleg*innen sie mittragen statt sie zu umgehen.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst verstehen, wie ein B2B-Sales-Prozess funktioniert, und das System dahinter mitgestalten. RevOps-Vorerfahrung ist dafür keine Voraussetzung.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, gelegentlich in unser Büro in Münster oder Berlin zu kommen, um Onboardings, Offboardings und Workshops zu begleiten.
  • Deutsch- & Englischkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mind. C1) und fließend Englisch (mind. B2).

Cherry on top

  • Erfahrung im Apple-MDM (Jamf, Kandji, Mosyle) oder Apple-Zertifizierungen (ACSP, ACiT)
  • Identity-Themen in der Tiefe: SSO, SCIM, OAuth-Scopes und Conditional Access
  • HubSpot-Administration in einem B2B-SaaS-Umfeld
  • ISO 27001 Zertifizierung

Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort

  • Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Einsatzort: Berlin oder Münster, deutschlandweit möglich. Etwa ein Mal im Monat kommst du für ein bis zwei Tage in unser Office nach Münster oder Berlin.

Deine Benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

  • Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

  • Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.

  • Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:

    • Upskilling: Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.
    • Equipment: Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
    • Steueroptimierte Benefits: Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.
    • Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.

jobs.description:
Projektmanager (m/w/d) Softwareprojekte Industrie

CodeWrights entwickelt individuelle Softwarelösungen für einige der weltweit führenden Industrieunternehmen. Als Spezialist für industrielle Software, Geräteintegration und digitale Produktentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, komplexe technische Herausforderungen erfolgreich zu lösen.

Du sorgst dafür, dass anspruchsvolle Software- und Entwicklungsprojekte zielgerichtet, transparent und verlässlich durch die Organisation geführt werden. Dabei koordinierst du Anforderungen, Ressourcen, Termine, Risiken und die Kommunikation zwischen allen Beteiligten und stellst sicher, dass Teams effizient zusammenarbeiten und gemeinsam optimale Lösungen für unsere Kunden entwickeln.

In deiner Rolle bist du weit mehr als klassischer PM: Du navigierst durch komplexe technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge, moderierst Entscheidungen, schaffst Transparenz und verbindest Kunden, Entwicklungsteams und Stakeholder zu einem leistungsfähigen Projektumfeld. Dabei behältst du sowohl die Kundenanforderungen als auch wirtschaftliche Ziele und die Dynamik im Team im Blick.

Wir sind eine Expertenorganisation mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einem modernen Dynamic-Work-Ansatz. Zusammenarbeit, Transparenz und Verantwortung dort, wo die Kompetenz liegt, prägen unsere Arbeitsweise.

Die Tür steht dir offen, wenn du Mut, Disziplin und die Fähigkeit mitbringst, anspruchsvolle Projekte erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu führen. Du verfügst über fundiertes technisches Verständnis und Projektmanagement-Erfahrung und gehst Themen nicht nur organisatorisch, sondern auch fachlich in der Tiefe an. Idealerweise hast du einen Hintergrund in der Softwareentwicklung, Elektrotechnik oder einem ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Umfeld und dich gezielt in Richtung Projektmanagement weiterentwickelt. Mit deiner starken Kommunikationsfähigkeit verbindest du Menschen, schaffst Vertrauen und führst Projekte erfolgreich zum Ziel.

Die Position ist an unserem Standort in Karlsruhe angesiedelt.

Aufgaben

Ganz konkret erwarten Dich unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Software- und Entwicklungsprojekte und führst diese hinsichtlich Zielerreichung, Qualität, Termin, Budget und Risiko zum Erfolg.
  • Du schaffst Transparenz über Anforderungen, Scope, Prioritäten, Abhängigkeiten und Entscheidungsbedarfe und sorgst für eine verlässliche Projektsteuerung.
  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden, Entwicklungsteams und interne Stakeholder und steuerst die Zusammenarbeit über alle Projektphasen hinweg.
  • Du koordinierst mehrere Projekte parallel, balancierst Ressourcen, Prioritäten und Kundenanforderungen und behältst dabei stets die wirtschaftlichen Ziele im Blick.
  • Du erkennst Risiken, Zielkonflikte und Änderungsbedarfe frühzeitig, triffst fundierte Entscheidungen und leitest geeignete Maßnahmen zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung ein.
  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf, verantwortest Projektcontrolling und Forecasts und bringst deine Erfahrungen zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Projektmanagement-Methoden ein.

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Steuerung von Software- oder technischen Entwicklungsprojekten im Kundenumfeld.
  • Du bringst einen technischen Hintergrund aus der Softwareentwicklung, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Umfeld mit und kannst technische Zusammenhänge sicher verstehen und einordnen.
  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, mehrere Projekte und unterschiedliche Stakeholder parallel zu koordinieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und auch bei zunehmender Komplexität den Überblick zu behalten.
  • Du überzeugst durch Eigeninitiative, Verlässlichkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein und bist bereit, Entscheidungen zu treffen und Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung zu übernehmen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe mit Kunden, Entwicklungsteams und internen Stakeholdern und kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven konstruktiv zusammenbringen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Von Vorteil sind außerdem:
Erfahrung mit Scrum, agilen oder hybriden Projektmanagementansätzen.
Kenntnisse in Jira, Polarion, Targetprocess oder vergleichbaren Tools.
Technischer Hintergrund in Softwareentwicklung, Embedded Systems oder industrieller Automatisierung.
Erfahrung in regulierten Umfeldern oder mit Themen wie IEC 62443, Industrial Cybersecurity, GMP/GAMP oder industriellen Kommunikationsprotokollen.

Benefits

Was Dich bei CodeWrights erwartet:

  • Verantwortung für spannende Entwicklungsprojekte bei namhaften internationalen Industrieunternehmen.
  • Große Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und viel Vertrauen in Deine Entscheidungen.
  • Eine Organisation mit Dynamic Work Design, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echter Mitgestaltung.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit hochqualifizierten Entwicklern, Architekten und Technologieexperten.
  • Die Möglichkeit, Projekte, Prozesse und die Zukunft unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Lebenslanges Lernen durch Weiterbildung, Wissenstransfer, Mentoring und persönliche Entwicklung.
  • Ein modernes Büro direkt am Karlsruher Hauptbahnhof mit sehr guter Anbindung.
  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und eine Arbeitsumgebung, die auf Eigenverantwortung statt Kontrolle setzt.

Chief Financial Officer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Chief Financial Officer (all genders)
Your mission

deskbird is one of Europe's fastest-growing workplace-management platforms – a SaaS success story serving hundreds of enterprise customers and building the operating system for the workplace of the future, well past €10M ARR and scaling with an efficiency-driven playbook. In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion.


We're hiring a Chief Financial Officer (all genders) to be a true co-pilot to the management team. This is not just a back-office finance role. You will sit in board meetings from day one, own the equity story, lead our future financing rounds and capital markets strategy, and run an AI-first operations function that becomes a case study in how lean a modern finance organization can be.


You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully.


If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat.



In this role you will

  1. The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board.

  2. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest.

  3. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department.

  4. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper.

  5. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally.

  6. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the  standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP.

  7. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders.

  8. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance.



What you need to be successful

Must-haves

  • A transaction-shaped career: ideally PE, M&A or investment banking, followed by operating experience in a scaling company - you’ve seen deals from the inside and know what investors actually sign up for. (Exceptional candidates from transaction advisory (e.g. Big4) or top-tier strategy consulting with strong deal exposure will also be considered.)
  • Deep fluency in finance processes and B2B SaaS mechanics: ARR/NRR, cohort economics, CAC payback, Rule of 40, the ARR-to-cash bridge.
  • Experience at our scale and complexity (>€10M ARR, ~100+ employees) - and ideally, you’ve already seen what comes next (>€25M ARR), so you know what to build now and what to deliberately skip.
  • Fundraising and/or liquidity event exposure, ideally where the story was efficient, profitable growth rather than growth at all costs.
  • A builder’s ego profile: you measure yourself by enterprise value created per person on your team, not by headcount or budget owned. You’re hands-on and want to stay that way.
  • Genuine excitement about AI-native ways of working - you’re already using these tools daily and want to push further.
  • Based in or willing to work from one of our hubs - Zurich, Berlin, Munich, or London (remote within Europe is possible for an outstanding candidate, but hub-based is our strong preference given the closeness to founders and board). Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred.
Nice to have
  • Experience owning or partnering closely with People & Culture.
  • Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll.
  • Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience.


What’s in it for you?


  • A rare stage - big enough to matter (>€10M ARR, enterprise customers, proven playbook), small enough that your fingerprints will be on everything.
  • Meaningful equity upside - a package built for a founder-like profile in a capital-efficient business, where the value you help create is value you share in.
  • A real seat at the table - board meetings from day one, direct partnership with the founders, and full ownership of your domain.
  • An AI-first culture - the freedom (and expectation) to build the most modern finance function in European SaaS.
  • A high-talent, low-ego executive team that moves fast and debates openly.

Head of Sales | Fund Administration | VC & PE | Private Markets

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Head of Sales at bunch, you will strengthen, lead and scale our sales team across key European markets — UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder, you will turn our high-touch executive commercial motion into a structured, repeatable sales engine across our key European markets.

You will lead Account Executives and Commercial Associates selling to sophisticated decision-makers across VC, PE, and alternative asset managers (GPs, CFOs, COOs, and Fund Ops teams). Because our business model combines scalable SaaS capabilities with high-touch fund services, sales cycles are relationship-driven, multi-stakeholder, and often long. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance

  • Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team

  • Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking

  • Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops

  • Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption

  • Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth

  • Coach the team on complex enterprise sales: discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, business-case building, negotiation, pricing, executive communication, and multi-threading

  • Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans

  • Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical

  • Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal & Finance, and our Co-Founders to advance commercial outcomes

  • Bring structured market feedback into company planning, including customer needs, competitor patterns, pricing insights, product gaps, and operational blockers

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire, onboard, ramp, and manage performance as the sales team expands

About you

  • You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins.

  • Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals.

  • Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first.

  • You have a track record of driving sales motions for high-ticket solutions where deal sizes are consistently in the hundreds of thousands, focusing on relationship-driven, consultative outcomes.

  • You have 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling Account Executives teams, with a clear track record of raising team performance, enforcing pipeline discipline, and driving revenue growth.

  • You have coached team members through long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • You have successfully built and scaled sales motions across multiple markets, driving high performance through rigorous CRM discipline, RevOps tooling, and predictable forecasting routines.

  • You excel at creating practical sales handbooks, enablement resources, playbooks, and coaching frameworks that teams rely on to drive complex, long-cycle enterprise deals.

  • You are a seasoned people leader who sets a high bar for excellence, fostering talent through direct feedback, clear performance management, and structured coaching.

  • You combine strong commercial judgment—knowing when to push or qualify out—with the executive presence to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders.

  • You have a builder mentality and are comfortable creating structure in an environment that is still scaling

  • You communicate excellently in English

Existing understanding of VC / PE fund operations, GP / LP structures, fund administration, investor onboarding, transfer agency, or Luxembourg fund structures is a strong plus.

What success looks like

In your first months, you will build a clear understanding of bunch’s commercial motion, ICP, product, implementation model, pricing, and market dynamics. You will establish trust with the existing sales team, founders, and key cross-functional partners, while introducing a clear cadence for pipeline reviews, deal coaching, forecasting, and performance visibility.

Over time, you will strengthen the team’s execution across priority markets, improve pipeline quality and forecast accuracy, standardise the sales playbook, support hiring and onboarding, and build stronger cross-functional routines with Marketing, Solutions, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps. You will also establish the core sales infrastructure the team needs to scale: clear funnel processes, reliable CRM workflows, useful dashboards, practical handbooks, repeatable coaching routines, and a shared source of truth for how we sell.

Ultimately, you will help build a high-performing and scalable sales organisation across UK, Luxembourg and Germany, improving predictable revenue generation and constantly raising the quality bar for complex private-markets selling.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Founder’s Interview (60 min) – Role deep dive, sales leadership, and commercial scope

  3. Sales Leadership Case (60 min) – Coaching, pipeline discipline, and complex deal execution

  4. Final Round (3 x 45 min) – Meet our leadership team (Tech, Ops, CS).

  5. In-person Meet & Greet with team members.

  6. Reference checks

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

Backed by over $55 million from top-tier investors like Sequoia Capital, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

The role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you are the first commercial point of contact with our prospects. You join Zefir's Sales team and reach out to homeowners who have run a valuation on our website but have not booked an appointment yet.

The core of the role is reactivation: these homeowners showed interest, then stopped there. You are the one who gets them moving again, on the phone, one by one.

Your goal as a BDR: create the sales opportunities that feed our revenue directly.

What you will do

  • Handle around 100 calls per day, with a target of 3 to 4 meetings booked daily.

  • Run qualification calls of about 20 minutes: understand the client's project, present Zefir's value proposition, and book a follow-up meeting with an Account Executive.

  • Keep rigorous track of your pipeline and move leads through the Sales funnel.

Senior Product Designer

Updated in September 2026

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

AI Engineer

Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.  
  • Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

 

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
  • Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
  • Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
  • Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
  • Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
  • Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). 
  • Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. 
  • Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
  • Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 

Equally important is how you think: 

  • You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
  • You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
  • You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
  • You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 

Nice to have: 

  • Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 

What we are not looking for: 

  • "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. 
  • Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
  • Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 

Benefits

  • Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
  • Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
  • Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
  • Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
  • Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

  • Innovation and Continuous Learning
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
  • Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

jobs.title: Head of GTM, Research Services | AI-Native Research (Remote US/EU)
jobs.description:
Head of GTM, Research Services | AI-Native Research (Remote US/EU)

About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

About the Role

Maze is launching a Market Research service that blends the scale and speed of our platform with expert-led research services, creating an AI-native alternative to traditional market research agencies.

As Head of GTM, Research Services, you'll be the founding commercial leader for this new line of business. This is a high-profile role that will work closely with Senior Leaders at Maze.

Reporting to the COO and partnering closely with our Head of Market Research, the expert practitioner delivering the service, you'll own go-to-market strategy end to end. Key responsibilities include partnering with Product, Sales and Marketing to design, build and run our GTM motion, engaging new buyers and existing customers to initiate opportunities, managing deals through to close, and working with Marketing to build Maze's voice and presence in the market research industry.

This is a rare opportunity to build a new business at an inflection point, helping define how AI reshapes the future of market research. You'll thrive here if you're a builder with deep market research roots—someone who has carried a number, knows the industry and its buyers personally, and believes AI is rewriting how research gets done.

What You'll Do:

GTM Strategy & Service Design

  • Define and co-own the go-to-market strategy for Maze's Market Research service; positioning, packaging, pricing, and target segments.

  • Partner with the Head of Market Research to shape the offering around what insights buyers actually need and what our AI-native approach makes possible.

  • Establish the metrics, forecasts, and operating cadence for a new line of business, and iterate quickly on what the market tells you.

Pipeline Generation & Sales Partnership

  • Coordinate with our existing sales team to generate qualified pipeline

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to deliver enablement, playbooks, joint account planning, and outbound plays.

  • Activate your own market research network to open doors with insights leaders and research buyers.

  • Manage opportunities through the full sales cycle: scoping, proposals, pricing, negotiation, and close - bringing in the Head of Market Research as the practitioner voice.

Marketing Partnership & Market Presence

  • Partner with Marketing to build Maze's voice and presence in the market research category—content, events, communities, and thought leadership.

  • Represent Maze at industry events and in the broader conversation about how AI is changing research.

  • Turn early customer wins into stories, references, and repeatable demand.

Building the Business

  • Act as the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Research, and Product, surfacing what the market needs and feeding it back into the service and platform roadmap.

  • Bring AI into your own daily workflow to do more with less—and model that for the team around you.

  • As the service scales, help shape the team and playbook that will grow it.

Who You Are:

Experience

  • Significant experience growing market research services, insights consulting, or research technology businesses, including ownership of commercial outcomes.

  • A very strong network of market research buyers and practitioners you can activate from day one.

  • Deep market research domain expertise: qual and quant methodologies, study design, and how insights organizations buy and operate.

  • Ideally, some management and entrepreneurial experience—you've built a practice, launched an offering, or started something of your own.

Skills & Strengths

  • AI-pilled: You understand how AI can improve every step of the research process, and you already use it daily to do more with less.

  • Builder: You thrive in zero-to-one environments—comfortable with ambiguity, quick to create structure, and energized by owning outcomes.

  • Consultative seller: You sell expertise, not just software—confident scoping complex research engagements and navigating enterprise buying processes.

  • Category evangelist: You have a point of view on where research is heading and can make buyers, analysts, and practitioners want to be part of it.

  • Cross-functional operator: You work fluidly with sales, marketing, research, and product teams, and know how to get things done without formal authority.

Bonus

  • Experience launching a new service or product line inside a scaling company.

  • Published thought leadership or public speaking on AI in market research.

  • Experience selling both platform (SaaS) and services (agency) motions.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture.

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

  • Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid

    • For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

  • Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources

  • Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid

  • Flexible time off

  • Meaningful equity

  • Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze

  • New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze

  • Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents

  • $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage

    • If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

  • $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space

  • Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours

  • Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more

  • Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year

  • SWAG, we have some really cool swag

  • Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here.

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application, as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year.

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. These customers are typically large accounts adopting Postgres and AI solutions. The Senior TAM serves as a trusted technical advisor to drive successful outcomes and to ensure that the customers become a positive reference and continue their journey on Postgres technology. The Senior TAM is also the customer's primary point of contact into all technical areas of EDB. As such, the Senior TAM’s technical abilities are critical in identifying solutions, architecture, troubleshooting issues, and answering technical questions as they arise.

  • Function as a front-line technical resource for "best practice" and informal customer questions

jobs.description:
Praktikant Business Building & AI Automation (m/w/d) – Digital Education mit Impact
Über uns – Talentspring Academy Group

Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht?

Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland verfügen über keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss, während gleichzeitig ganze Branchen durch KI, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle transformiert werden. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren.

Die Talentspring Academy Group baut eine neue Generation von Bildungsplattformen für die Arbeitswelt von morgen. Wir qualifizieren Arbeitssuchende, Quereinsteiger:innen und Beschäftigte für gefragte Tätigkeiten in Bereichen wie Online Marketing, Digital Sales und Künstliche Intelligenz.

Mit unserem hybriden Modell aus digitaler Plattform und physischer Infrastruktur – über 900 Standorte bundesweit durch unseren Partner Studienkreis – schaffen wir eine neue Kategorie im deutschen Weiterbildungsmarkt.

Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt, um einzusteigen – und mitzugestalten, wie Bildung in Deutschland neu gedacht wird. Bist Du dabei?


Über die Rolle

Als Praktikant Business Building & AI Automation baust du die internen Systeme, mit denen unsere Organisation skaliert: Tools, Datenstrecken und Automatisierungen, die Arbeit übernehmen, die heute noch Menschen erledigen.

Du arbeitest im Venture-Building-Team und berichtest direkt an unseren CEO. Wir sind builders within: ein Team, das im Unternehmen selbst baut – interne Produkte, Systeme und neue Geschäftsmodelle – statt Konzepte für andere zu schreiben. Du kommst also nicht als einzelne Automatisierungskraft in eine Fachabteilung, sondern in eine Gruppe, die dasselbe Handwerk betreibt wie du.

Unsere Sales-Organisation umfasst aktuell 30 Personen und wächst schnell. Parallel entwickeln wir eine HubSpot-basierte CRM-Architektur, neue B2B-Strukturen und eine datengetriebene Marketing- und Sales Engine. Genau in diesem Umbau setzt deine Arbeit an.

Eng zusammen arbeitest du mit Infrastruktur & Data. Die Rolle liegt an der Schnittstelle von:

  • Marketing und Sales
  • Operations und Akademie
  • CRM und Tech Stack
  • Data und Analytics
  • Venture Building und neue Geschäftsmodelle

Kurz gesagt: Du baust an unserem internen Betriebssystem – und setzt selbst um, was du entworfen hast. Für reine Strategie- oder Analystenarbeit ist die Rolle nicht gedacht: Hier wird gebaut, eingeführt und gemessen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Process Intelligence & Automation: Du durchleuchtest Abläufe in Marketing, Sales, Operations und Akademie, bewertest sie nach Aufwand, Häufigkeit und wirtschaftlichem Hebel und automatisierst die Prozesse mit dem größten Effekt.
  • Internal Tools & Rapid Prototyping: Du baust mit KI- und No-Code-Werkzeugen (z. B. n8n, KI-Agenten) interne Anwendungen und Prototypen, testest sie direkt im laufenden Betrieb und übernimmst Rollout, Dokumentation und Einweisung der Teams.

jobs.title: SEO Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
SEO Lead (f/m/d)

About the Job

We're looking for an SEO Lead to take ownership of our affiliate portfolio and scale it. You'll work with some of the biggest publishers in the world and have a direct impact on revenue.

You'll drive SEO strategy across multiple affiliate sites spanning a wide variety of verticals, lead continuous go-lives into new markets, and manage a small team of SEO Content Managers. You'll have the autonomy to set direction, prioritize what moves the needle, and act fast when things change - because in SEO, they always do.

At WLX, SEO isn't a support function - it's a driving force. We have the resources, the management backing, and the hands-on expertise to make things happen. And unlike an agency, everything we build is ours: our own projects, run in close collaboration with the world's biggest publishers. That means real ownership, real impact, and no client briefs.

If you thrive on launching new projects, love the pace of a high-growth environment, and want to shape a growing portfolio worth millions across a constantly expanding range of verticals - this is the role for you. You'll report to the Head of Product and collaborate closely with publishers, vertical managers, and content teams to turn SEO opportunities into measurable business results.

This is what you'll do

  • Lead revenue expansion of existing affiliate sites: Develop and implement long-term SEO strategies, optimize high-value pages for rankings and CTR, and own backlink campaigns across multiple affiliate sites.
  • Launch new affiliate sites end to end: From keyword clustering, topic mapping, content structure, and coordinating stakeholders to take new sites live from scratch.
  • Drive on-page and off-page performance: Conduct content audits, improve SERP feature capture, manage link-building tactics, and work with agencies and publishers to strengthen domain authority.
  • Identify and unlock growth opportunities: Research publishers, size new markets, assess domain authority and traffic trends, and weigh expansion options against business growth frameworks.
  • Manage and develop a team of SEO Content Managers: Set clear priorities, hold people accountable, coach for growth, and have the hard conversations when needed.

This is what you’ve got

  • Substantial on-page and off-page experience in SEO, with a track record of driving organic growth at scale.
  • Proven experience managing a team and getting the best out of people while keeping standards high.
  • C2 German and fluent in English (C1+), you can operate confidently with stakeholders in both languages.
  • Ideally based in Berlin, although we're also open to remote candidates
  • Analytical and structured - you prioritize what matters, communicate clearly, and make decisions under pressure.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, flat, startup-style environment.
  • Experience in iGaming or other affiliate marketing industries is a plus.

About Us

At We Love X, we build and run high-performing comparison platforms and conversion funnels that connect millions of users with the right products and services. As a market leader in SEA-based affiliation across multiple verticals, we turn high-intent traffic into scalable growth for our partners. Over the past years, we’ve also built one of the fastest-growing SEO businesses in our space, partnering with some of the world’s largest publishers. Beyond our own sites, We Love X constantly incubates new, performance-marketing-driven business models – from first idea to international scale.

Du begleitest sie beim Onboarding, führst Schulungen durch, löst Support-Anfragen und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Gleichzeitig trägst Du aktiv dazu bei, unsere Services zu skalieren — durch Self-Service-Angebote, Wissensdatenbanken und perspektivisch KI-gestützte Prozesse.

Aufgaben

Qualifikation

  • Du besitzt zwei Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Support, Customer Success oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit entsprechend technischem Ausbildungshintergrund.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch dein technisches Wissen, eine stets kunden- und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und deine Verbindlichkeit aus. Dabei bist du gut organisiert, eigenständig und verfügst über ein exzellentes Zeitmanagement.
