  • Als Unternehmen leben wir eine moderne Kollaboration. Intuitive und zeitsparende Tools sind fest in unseren Alltag integriert.
  • Dich begrüßen erfahrene Teamplayer in einem motivierten Team. Nach Deiner ausführlichen Einarbeitung arbeitest Du in diesem selbstständig.
  • Dich erwarten vielfältige Möglichkeiten für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung sowie eine optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere mit uns die Arbeitswelt in Anwaltskanzleien. Gestalte Deine Zukunft bei dokSAFE GmbH und bewirb Dich jetzt - wir freuen uns auf Dich!

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager

SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!


About the role

Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it.

This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time.

Here's how you'll make a difference

  • Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset.

  • Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery.

  • Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it.

  • Manage multi-team migrations where downstream consumers, external commitments, and legacy constraints all need to land in the right order. A missed dependency here costs months, not days.

  • Run the mechanics that keep a dozen concurrent programs honest: dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and the recurring check-ins nobody wants to run but everybody needs.

  • Bring rigor to how delivery health gets measured, incident counts, adoption rates, time-to-land, and use it to drive change instead of producing another report.

What makes you a great fit

  • You've run complex, cross-functional technical programs and can point to ones where the technical decisions were yours to shape, not just to track.

  • You hold your own in deep engineering conversations. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being argued about and why it matters.

  • You bring structure to ambiguity without over-engineering it. Your default is the lightest mechanism that solves the problem.

  • You've worked where the consumers of your output are other engineering teams, whether that's infrastructure, data pipelines, or internal APIs.

  • You've managed a migration or sunset with real downstream impact, and you know how to land it without breaking trust.

  • You communicate directly. Short sentences, clear asks, no filler. You write decisions down and make sure the right people see them.

  • You're comfortable in Jira, Confluence, and the rest of a modern engineering toolchain, and you have opinions about how they should be used.

Nice to have

  • Background in infrastructure, data engineering, or applied AI/ML platforms.

  • Experience inside a SaaS company through a phase of platform consolidation or modernization.

  • Familiarity with SLOs or monitoring practice as a delivery signal, not just an SRE artifact.

What success looks like

  • 3 months. You're embedded with the team's engineering leadership, have a clear read on every active program, and have started reshaping how the group plans, tracks, and communicates delivery.

  • 6 months. You're the trusted operating partner for the group. Initiatives that were drifting are landing predictably, and the cross-team dependencies that used to surprise us are surfacing weeks earlier.

  • 12 months. The team is delivering with a rhythm other groups want to copy. The mechanisms you built are running themselves, and you're picking the next compounding problem to solve.

 

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

  • Onboarding and setup: Help operators connect their channels, add properties and get value from the platform quickly.

  • Booking and guest journeys: Create smooth experiences for direct bookings, check-in, extensions and upsells.

  • Our design system: Build reusable components and consistent interaction patterns that keep the platform coherent as it grows.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Product Engineer

The Context

Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.

Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.

We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.

The Mission

You'll own features in their entirety. Self-standing or with guidance of founders and fellow engineers, you turn a clear problem statement into a strong design and build, test, and ship new features that directly enable our customers. You integrate features across our layered stack, from the API to the data plane, and carry them all the way to production.

This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.

Your responsibilities

  • Ship features end-to-end: Deliver complete vertical slices across the stack, from the API layer to the data model, carried through to running in production.

  • Grow what the platform does for banks: Build the services Porters performs for banks: Extend the capabilities of our agentic platform such as case handling, customer matching, AI tool integrations, data enrichment, or keeping humans in the loop.

  • Deliver features that hold together as a system: Design endpoints, contracts, and interfaces that work together, ensuring features integrate cleanly towards one bigger outcome.

  • Ensure your work is reliable: Own design, development, tests, and deployment, so what reaches production is proven to work.

  • Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”.

Your profile

  • Experience: Around 4 years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

  • Product thinking: You naturally understand why you’re building something, not just focusing on how to build.

  • Quality focus & individual problem solving: Given a clear problem, you reliably produce a clean algorithm, a sensible data model, a well-structured service. You treat tests and observability as part of the feature, and right-size rigor to risk. You are comfortable in a regulated fintech environment where precision matters.

  • Technical proficiency: Proficiency in Python is mandatory, along with REST API development, an ORM, and relational databases.

  • AI-native: You've worked with, or are eager to work with, LLM/agentic tooling, and understand how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

  • Collaboration and eagerness to learn: You thrive on direction, review, and challenge, take feedback well, and want to grow into larger scopes. You are eager to learn every day.

  • Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer

  • Ownership from day one: Real features running in production at major financial institutions, with the trust to carry them there yourself.

  • Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

  • We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

  • Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack

  • Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

  • Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

  • AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

  • Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

jobs.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer Next.js
jobs.description:
Junior Full-Stack Developer Next.js

Seit der Übernahme durch die CHAPTERS Group AG im Jahr 2025 baut die Linear Service GmbH neben ihrem etablierten Kernsystem für Vereinsverwaltung und Buchhaltung ein komplett neues Cloud-Produkt auf. Das bestehende System bleibt – es läuft weiter und wird von unseren Kunden aus Vereinen, Verbänden und Schulen täglich genutzt. Parallel dazu entsteht auf der grünen Wiese eine moderne Cloud-Produktlinie, von Anfang an mit agentenbasierten AI-Features (Chatbot, Copilot, MCP) gedacht. Dahinter stehen 35 Jahre Erfahrung und ein treuer Kundenstamm – vor uns liegt eine agentenbasierte Zukunft, die wir jetzt gestalten.

Für dieses neue Produkt suchen wir einen Junior Developer (m/w/d), der nicht mit jahrelanger Erfahrung kommt, sondern mit der richtigen Haltung: Du entwickelst von Anfang an AI-first – Coding-Agenten sind für dich kein Hilfsmittel, sondern dein Standard-Workflow – und du willst lernen, wie man Agenten nicht nur nutzt, sondern selbst baut und orchestriert.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen und wächst Schritt für Schritt vom Frontend über APIs bis zur Datenbank in die gesamte Plattform hinein. Das Next.js-Ökosystem musst du noch nicht blind beherrschen – du musst es lernen wollen.

Aufgaben

  • Feature-Entwicklung: Umsetzung klar abgegrenzter Features in unserer neuen Next.js-Cloud-Plattform (React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL) – mit Mentoring, wachsender Eigenverantwortung und Code-Reviews durch den CTO.
  • AI-First Development: Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding-Agenten (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot o. ä.), beherrschst Planung, Delegation und Review von agentengeneriertem Code und hilfst uns, unsere AI-Entwicklungsworkflows weiter zu verbessern.
  • Agenten-Orchestrierung: Mitarbeit an unseren AI-Features – Tool-Anbindungen über MCP, Agent-Flows mit LangGraph, Prompt-Design, Evals und Guardrails für Chatbot und Copilot.
  • Frontend: Moderne, responsive Benutzeroberflächen mit React/Next.js bauen.
  • Backend-Grundlagen: API-Endpunkte und Datenbankabfragen umsetzen und dabei Schritt für Schritt Full-Stack-Kompetenz aufbauen.
  • Qualität & Dokumentation: Tests schreiben, Features dokumentieren – so, dass auch KI-Agenten damit arbeiten können.

Qualifikation

  • Tech-Stack: Solide Basis in JavaScript/TypeScript und erste praktische Erfahrung mit React und Next.js – aus Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, Bootcamp oder eigenen Projekten. SQL und git sitzen.
  • AI-First-Mindset (Muss): Du programmierst bereits mit KI-gestützten Tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot etc.) und kannst zeigen, was du damit gebaut hast.
  • Bereitschaft zur Agenten-Orchestrierung (Muss): Du willst verstehen, wie LLM-Agenten funktionieren – Tool Calling, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, Prompting, Evaluation – und hast idealerweise schon eigene kleine Agenten, Chatbots oder MCP-Server gebaut.
  • Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium (Informatik o. ä.), Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker/in – oder Quereinstieg mit nachweisbarem Portfolio.
  • Lernkurve: Hohe Eigeninitiative, schnelle Einarbeitung, Freude daran, aus Reviews und Fehlern zu lernen.
  • Sprache & Rechtliches: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland.
  • Nice-to-have: PostgreSQL, Next.js App Router, Erfahrung mit LangGraph/LangChain in einem eigenen Projekt, Open-Source-Beiträge, Grundkenntnisse in der Buchhaltung oder Vereinsarbeit.

Benefits

  • Mentoring: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CTO, regelmäßige Code-Reviews, steile Lernkurve.
  • Freier Gestaltungsspielraum: Volle Freiheit bei der Wahl deines Development-Setups und deiner bevorzugten Coding-Agenten.
  • Echte Grüne Wiese: Keine Altlasten – du baust von Anfang an an einem neuen Cloud-Produkt mit.
  • 100 % Flexibilität: Komplett remote-fähig, flexible Zeiteinteilung; Büro in Berlin Mitte, wenn du magst.
  • Mobilität: Deutschlandticket wird übernommen.
  • Entwicklung: Weiterbildung und Austausch mit mehr als 60 anderen Softwareunternehmen der CHAPTERS Group.
  • Sport & Gesundheit: Geförderte Mitgliedschaft über den Urban Sports Club.

Entfalte dein Potenzial als Junior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js) bei Linear Service GmbH! Gestalte Software, die Vereinen hilft, mehr zu erreichen. Werde Teil unserer 35-jährigen Erfolgsgeschichte!

jobs.title: Lead, Special Projects
jobs.description:
Lead, Special Projects

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

About the Role

You will be responsible for building and running the operational infrastructure behind ActAI.

This includes setting up new offices and entities, implementing payroll and local operations, managing vendors, supporting recruiting operations, and ensuring the company can execute efficiently as it scales.

You will be responsible for operational execution across markets.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead business operations across multiple countries.

  • Manage and develop a team of Business Operations Partners.

  • Oversee office setup, entity incorporation, and market launches.

  • Oversee payroll implementation and local operational requirements.

  • Manage external vendors and service providers.

  • Support recruiting operations, recruiter onboarding, and hiring activities.

  • Plan and execute company events, offsites, and operational logistics.

  • Track key initiatives and ensure actions are completed on time.

  • Improve processes where needed to increase speed and reliability.

What You Will Need

  • Experience in business operations, strategic operations, founder's office, or similar roles.

  • Experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments.

  • Comfortable working across recruiting, finance, legal, and administrative functions.

  • Able to identify problems, make decisions, and drive execution independently.

  • High ownership and willingness to take responsibility for outcomes.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

jobs.description:
Campaign Operations Manager

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW

The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow.

We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation.

YOUR MISSION

As Campaign Operations Manager, your mission will be to own the successful delivery and optimisation of digital advertising campaigns from initial planning through to post-campaign analysis.

You’ll ensure campaigns launch accurately, deliver against their objectives and provide an excellent experience for our clients and internal teams. You’ll proactively solve delivery challenges, identify opportunities to maximise revenue and use data to turn campaign performance into valuable insights.

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while helping Campaign Operations become smarter, more efficient and increasingly scalable.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of digital advertising campaigns, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

  • Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives.

  • Monitor campaign performance and proactively optimise activity to improve delivery and results.

  • Troubleshoot campaign issues, resolve blockers and minimise delivery and revenue risk.

  • Produce high-quality campaign reports and post-campaign analysis decks that translate performance data into clear, actionable insights.

  • Present campaign performance, findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and external clients when required.

  • Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners.

  • Identify commercial opportunities, including campaign upweights, extensions and improvements that could deliver additional value for clients and Carwow.

  • Continuously review Campaign Operations processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability.

  • Support the adoption of automation, AI and new technology across Campaign Operations while maintaining strong quality-control standards.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience managing and delivering digital advertising campaigns within a publisher, media owner, agency or ad-tech environment.

  • Strong understanding of digital advertising operations, campaign setup, optimisation, delivery and reporting.

  • Experience using an ad server or campaign management platform, ideally Google Ad Manager.

  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines at the same time.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations.

  • A proactive approach to identifying risks, resolving problems and improving campaign performance.

  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.

  • Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain campaign performance clearly.

  • A commercially minded approach, with an understanding of how effective campaign management supports revenue and client retention.

  • A collaborative, adaptable mindset and an interest in improving processes through technology, automation and AI.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience working within the automotive, publishing or digital media industry.

  • Knowledge of programmatic advertising, paid social, YouTube or off-site display campaigns.

  • Experience with demand-generation or lead-generation campaigns.

  • Familiarity with platforms such as DV360, Meta Ads Manager, Salesforce, Driftrock or audience-management platforms.

  • Previous involvement in process-improvement, automation or AI projects.

WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

Campaign Operations is a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with responsibility for delivering commercially important campaigns against tight deadlines and changing priorities.

You’ll need to be comfortable managing multiple campaigns, taking ownership and proactively identifying potential issues before they affect delivery. You’ll also work closely with different teams to find solutions and should be motivated to challenge and improve existing ways of working not simply follow established processes.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Online interview with the Hiring Manager

  • In-person presentation interview

  • Values Interview

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Competitive comp package

  • 28 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 35 with length of service, plus extras for house moves, weddings and more!

  • Employee-friendly share options

  • Pension scheme via Royal London - up to 5% company contribution

  • Vitality private healthcare insurance

  • Life Assurance - 4x annual salary

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, including up to 20 weeks' full pay maternity and shared parental leave, and 8 weeks' full partner pay, as well as fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • 'Work from abroad for a month' annual scheme

  • Generous learning and development budget

  • £500/€550 home office budget

We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

Founding Engineer (Tech Lead)

The Context

Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.

Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.

We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.

The Mission

You'll own the outcomes. You take an ambiguous business problem and turn it into clear requirements, a design with clear business rationale, sequenced work, and a realistic estimate, build the hardest parts yourself, and multiply a team of mid-level engineers with well-defined, extensible work and the reviews that keep quality high. You stay an IC at heart while making the work legible, sized, and worth doing.

This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.

Your responsibilities

  • Deliver the highest-risk work yourself: Be the IC where it matters. Personally engineer the most complex, business-critical components, from cross-service logic to the boundary where AI outputs become deterministic, auditable actions, and set the technical bar for the team as you go.

  • Turn business goals into shipped projects: Take an ambiguous problem and own it through to delivery, defining requirements, a design that starts from customer impact and takes the highest-ROI path whether it's make or buy, sequenced work, estimates, and clear engineering acceptance criteria a team can execute with minimal churn.

  • Design complex systems that don’t break down in 12 months: Architect entire systems so the likely next requirement plugs in cleanly through configuration or a new adapter, keeping components reusable and loosely coupled, separating business logic from shared services, and maintaining a single authoritative, append-only source of truth for critical data - including consideration of make-or-buy options.

  • Scale the team's autonomy and quality: Set decision thresholds so engineers self-serve low-stakes calls, define sanctioned paths for experimenting with regulated data, and spread understanding of our systems to cut key-person risk. Settle design in review, then build the road to production: CI/CD with quality gates, automated migrations, and systems that report their own health.

  • Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request, and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters made my day!”?

Your profile

  • Experience: Typically 8+ years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

  • IC strength: A hands-on builder who ships the hard things, and who naturally thinks in business outcomes, work packages, ROI, and extensibility.

  • Project definition: Proven ability to write requirements and designs from business context, break them into estimated, sequenced work, and drive a project to completion in a tool like Linear.

  • Technical proficiency: Deep proficiency in Python is mandatory, with strong command of REST API design, relational data modeling, and layered, service-oriented architecture.

  • AI-native: Real experience building LLM/agentic tooling, and understanding how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

  • Natural leader: You lift the people around you through design review, coaching, and clear direction, and you enjoy doing it.

  • Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of whole product areas: Latitude to shape what we build and how we scope, sequence, and ship it, with a team to build it with.

  • Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

  • We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

  • Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

  • Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack

  • Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

  • Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

  • AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

  • Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

  • Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

  • Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

  • Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.

Senior Site Reliability Engineer | SRE (Remote, EU/CET)

About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build secure, reliable, and scalable systems as Maze grows.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, reliability, and security. You’ll work across our platform to improve how we operate production systems, strengthen our security practices, and give engineers the tooling and infrastructure they need to ship quickly and confidently.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across boundaries, takes ownership, and brings a pragmatic approach to solving problems. You don’t need to be an expert in every part of our stack, but you should be excited to learn, move quickly, and make an impact.

As an SRE at Maze, you will:

  • Build, operate, and evolve our cloud infrastructure with reliability, scalability, and security in mind

  • Improve our observability practices and help engineers understand, debug, and operate systems in production

  • Partner across engineering and security to strengthen our cloud security posture and operational practices

  • Support security and compliance initiatives, including vulnerability management, security testing, and audit readiness

  • Build tooling and automation that reduces manual work and improves the developer experience

  • Bring an operational and security perspective to architecture and technical decisions

  • Improve how we prepare for, respond to, and learn from production incidents

  • Use modern AI-assisted and agentic workflows to build, debug, and operate systems more effectively

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has experience building and operating production systems in a modern cloud environment, ideally AWS

  • Understands modern SRE and infrastructure practices, including infrastructure as code and containerized workloads

  • Has experience with observability and knows what good monitoring, alerting, and production visibility look like

  • Brings a security mindset, with experience or interest in cloud security, vulnerability management, application security, or related areas

  • Has exposure to security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, or is interested in developing deeper expertise in this area

  • Can automate repetitive work using code and is comfortable working with at least one programming language

  • Is excited about AI-assisted development and actively uses modern AI tools in their work

  • Thrives in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and pragmatic decision-making matter

The stack

  • Cloud & infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & compliance: Vanta, Socket

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Argo CD

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Snowflake

  • Application: TypeScript, Node.js, React

You don’t need experience with every technology in our stack. We care more about strong fundamentals, an ability to learn quickly, and excitement about helping us build reliable and secure systems as Maze scales.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture.

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

jobs.title: Enterprise Risk Officer, ECRM
jobs.description:
Enterprise Risk Officer, ECRM

About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role:

The Enterprise Risk Officer will support the continued development of key components of our Second-Line of Defence (2LOD) Enterprise Risk Management program within the Enterprise Risk & Compliance team. In this role, you will support Senior Management by leading and coordinating core risk work-streams such as our enterprise risk register, risk assessments, typical enterprise risk processes, and oversight of the risk champion network. You will be partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Security, Product and other key stakeholders. This role blends enterprise risk and project management to ensure that our enterprise risk framework is robust, auditable, and fit for a fast scaling business.

Who You Are:

  • A Risk Management Professional: You have experience supporting or delivering risk management activities within a regulated or structured environment with specific focus on enterprise, operational and regulatory risk. You are familiar with identifying, assessing, and monitoring risks, and you understand how enterprise risk frameworks operate in practice. You have at least 2+ years of experience in risk, compliance, audit, or a related function.
  • A Governance and Controls Specialist: You have a solid understanding of enterprise risk and risk management control frameworks and how they support effective governance. You are experienced in drafting and developing policies, procedures, and risk mitigation plans, and can translate regulatory or internal requirements into practical processes that can be implemented and maintained across the organization.
  • A Self-Starter with a Builder Mindset: You are highly analytical and capable of assessing complex information to identify potential and emerging operational, regulatory, and enterprise-level risks. You are comfortable building processes and maintaining items such as risk registers, tracking mitigation actions, and ensuring that risk data is accurate, up to date, and clearly documented.
  • A Strong Communicator: You are confident engaging with stakeholders across different levels of the organization. You can explain risk concepts in clear, business-friendly language and are comfortable preparing reports, summaries, and presentations for senior management and committees.
  • A Collaborative Partner: You work effectively with business units to embed risk awareness into day-to-day operations. You are approachable and supportive, helping teams understand their risk responsibilities while building strong working relationships across functions.
  • Proactive and Solutions-Focused: You don’t just identify risks—you think about how to manage them. You are comfortable proposing practical, proportionate mitigation strategies and supporting their implementation, even in evolving or ambiguous environments.
  • Organized and Accountable: You are skilled at managing multiple priorities, tracking actions, and meeting deadlines. You take ownership of your work and ensure that commitments are followed through to completion.
  • Committed to Continuous Improvement: You are interested in enhancing risk processes, training, tools, and frameworks. You look for opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and contribute to a mature risk culture within the organization.

What You’ll Do:

  • Assist in identifying, assessing, and monitoring risks across the organisation to ensure effective mitigation strategies are in place.
  • Support enterprise-wide risk management workflows, including presenting insights and updates to leadership as required.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of risk policies, procedures, and controls in line with best practice.
  • Support the ongoing maintenance of the risk register, ensuring risks are accurately recorded and regularly reviewed.
  • Assist in preparing risk reports and dashboards for senior management and relevant committees.
  • Work with business units to promote a strong risk culture and enhance risk awareness across the organization.
  • Support compliance with regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.
  • Assist with internal audits and provide support during external audit processes as required.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.title: Contract Senior Staff Product Manager (US - East)
jobs.description:
Contract Senior Staff Product Manager (US - East)

Who We Are

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform coupled with an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 500 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce at our company. At Cobalt we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations in order to continue to nurture our unique rich diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

Description

All organizations need security testing for their software and we are building the world’s largest and smartest pentest management platform to help solve this challenge at scale.

As a Contract Senior Staff Product Manager, you will drive the definition, delivery, and adoption of new product features and ecosystem integrations. You will be responsible for taking the lead of our next gen deliverables, from user discovery and roadmap prioritization to go-to-market execution - ensuring that our platform evolves to solve the most pressing challenges in the security workflow.

This is a full-time contractor position providing hourly coverage from October through the end of February. In this role, you will merge attention to detail with the ability to understand and align business objectives, while working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to drive customer insights and inputs directly into the development process. You will work closely with our other Customer Experience and Pentester Experience teams.

What You Would Do

As a member of a growing team of product managers your responsibilities include:

  • Rapidly acquire new technical knowledge while maintaining meticulous attention to detail. Champion the strategic product direction across the organization, ensuring internal and external synchronization while serving as a subject matter expert on industry developments and defensive security operations.
  • Represent our customers. Work with Product Design, Product Marketing, Sales and Customer Success teams to bring the customer’s voice into the development process.
  • Manage the platform next-gent feature deliverables . Make tough tactical prioritization decisions while enabling the company to think long-term.
  • Collaborate across teams. We win or lose as a team. Product managers are a critical role in creating alignment between engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Have familiarity with information security, security operations, vulnerability disclosure, vulnerability management and other security domain areas.
  • Become an expert in pentesting best practices. You are ready to discuss and demonstrate product details with developers, product designers, security operations, pentesters, customers and sales prospects.
  • Measure success. Own the measures used to define success for your product. Success measures must be defined at the inception of a product and tracked throughout its lifecycle. Make measures visible to all stakeholders and interpret them into actionable conclusions and new hypotheses.
  • Lead Go-to-Market (GTM) Readiness: Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to orchestrate successful feature launches. Develop launch strategies, create internal training materials, and support the creation of customer-facing collateral to ensure seamless adoption.
  • Maintain technical fluency in the operational workflows of modern cybersecurity tools, including vulnerability management or offensive security platforms. Evaluate how these tools function within a customer’s security environment to inform product development.

You Must Have

  • 8+ years experience in Product Management and 3+ years experience in cybersecurity tools (vulnerability management or offensive security platforms), with a demonstrated ability to discover new opportunities and then define and deliver products. Experience in fast-growing software companies is a plus.
  • Strong technical skills - you can work alongside customers to help debug and improve our integration offerings.
  • Strong customer and stakeholder empathy. You must not only be the voice of the customer but at various times the voice of marketing, finance, engineering, sales and customer success. You must be able to channel many points of view.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You’re great at explaining highly technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences, with a talent for building empathy for user problems.
  • Strong analytical capabilities is a plus.
  • Strong bias for action, creative thinking, innovation and data-driven product decision-making.
  • A can-do attitude and ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience with agile software development.
  • Experience working with global team members (This team is a global team).
  • Hands-on experience with core cybersecurity tooling (e.g., DAST/SAST scanners, vulnerability management systems, or pentest workflow platforms). Articulate how security teams utilize these tools to identify, prioritize, and remediate risk, understanding the "why" behind the tooling workflow beyond simple API integrations.
  • Strong technical and product communication skills: Ability to translate complex security concepts into clear documentation, user guides, and release notes tailored to both technical developers and business stakeholders.
  • Full-time availability for the duration of the contract. You must be able to commit to full-time hourly coverage from October through the end of February, with no planned extended absences or vacations during the contract period (excluding recognized company holiday’s).

Pay Range Disclosure (For US openings only)

Cobalt is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The hourly range for this role is $84 - $106. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. The salary range may differ in other states and may be impacted by proximity to major metropolitan cities.

Cobalt (the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer, and we want the best available persons for every job. The Company makes employment decisions only based on merit. It is the Company's policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company.

Cobalt is an E-Verify employer. E-Verify is an Internet-based system operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA). It allows participating employers to electronically verify the employment eligibility of their newly hired employees in the United States.

Head of AI & Data (m/w/d)
Deine Aufgaben

Die Eberhardt Service Group steht für modernes, nachhaltiges Facility Management und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Leistungen. Digitalisierung, künstliche Intelligenz und die intelligente Nutzung von Daten eröffnen dabei enorme Chancen: Prozesse können einfacher werden, Mitarbeitende entlastet, Entscheidungen besser getroffen und unsere Leistungen für Kunden weiterentwickelt werden. 
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die AI & Data nicht nur strategisch denkt, sondern ins Unternehmen bringt und messbare Wirkung erzeugt. 
Als Head of AI & Data (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von AI, Data und digitalen Lösungen innerhalb der Eberhardt Service Group. Du verbindest Unternehmensstrategie, operative Prozesse und Technologie und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren:

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die AI- und Data-Strategie der Eberhardt Service Group und übersetzt sie in eine klare Roadmap und konkrete Maßnahmen.

  • Du führst und entwickelst das AI-&-Data-Team, baust die entsprechenden Kompetenzen im Unternehmen weiter aus und arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Führungskräften und Fachbereichen zusammen.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in AI, Data, Digitalisierung, Automatisierung oder Technologie. 
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von AI-/Data-Strategien und konkreten Use Cases. 
  • Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams und/oder größeren Projekten sowie in der Verantwortung für Budgets und Ressourcen. 
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, digitale, AI- oder Data-Lösungen aufzubauen, einzuführen und zu skalieren. 
  • Verständnis für Claude, Python, Generative AI, LLMs, AI-Agenten und Automatisierung. 
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Data Governance, Datenplattformen, Analytics und Datenqualität.
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Systemen wie SAP BO oder ELO. 
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud- und AI-Plattformen, idealerweise im Microsoft-Umfeld 
  • Verständnis für den gesamten AI-Lifecycle – von der Idee über Piloten bis zum produktiven Betrieb. 
  • Erfahrung mit Business Cases, ROI-Betrachtungen und der wirtschaftlichen Bewertung von Technologie. 
  • Grundlegendes Verständnis moderner IT- und Microsoft-Umgebungen. 
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst mit der Geschäftsführung über Strategie und Investitionen sprechen, mit operativen Führungskräften über Prozesse und mit technischen Spezialisten über Architektur, Daten und AI.

Dabei bist du weit mehr als eine Schnittstelle: Du bist Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung, Impulsgeber und Umsetzungstreiber – mit einem unternehmensweiten Blick auf Performance, Prozesse und Wachstum. 

  • Du bist die zentrale Kommunikations- und Steuerungsschnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung und Führungskräften.
  • Du übersetzt strategische Prioritäten gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung in konkrete Ziele, Projekte und Maßnahmen.
  • Du steuerst und verfolgst unternehmensweite Initiativen und stellst sicher, dass Verantwortlichkeiten, KPIs und Deadlines klar definiert und eingehalten werden.
  • Du etablierst und moderierst regelmäßige Management- und Performance-Reviews mit den verantwortlichen Führungskräften.
  • Du schaffst Transparenz über die Performance der verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche und bereitest Management-Reports, Analysen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor.
  • Du identifizierst Engpässe, Ineffizienzen und Risiken und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen konkrete Lösungen.
  • Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und Strukturen und treibst deren Standardisierung, Digitalisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung voran.
  • Du entwickelst Strukturen und Prozesse so weiter, dass sie mit unserem Wachstum effizient und skalierbar bleiben.
  • Du übernimmst ausgewählte strategische Sonderprojekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung.

Für uns ist weniger entscheidend, welchen Jobtitel du bisher hattest. Entscheidend ist, dass du unternehmerisch denkst, komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell verstehst und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernimmst.

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, idealerweise inBetriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre, Rechtswissenschaftenoder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsstärke, insbesondere im Austausch mit Führungskräften
  • Die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenzubringen und gleichzeitig konsequent auf Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse hinzuarbeiten
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Pragmatismus und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität
  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit Excel und datenbasierten Analysen

  • Erfahrung im Facility Management oder in einer vergleichbaren operativen Dienstleistungsbranche ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss


Warum wir?

Bei uns übernimmst du nicht einfach eine neue Position. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, direkt an der weiteren Entwicklung eines wachsenden Unternehmens mitzuwirken und gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung Strukturen, Prozesse und Prioritäten aktiv zu gestalten.

  • Direkter Einfluss & Verantwortung: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, bekommst tiefen Einblick in unsere Unternehmenssteuerung und kannst Entscheidungen aktiv mitgestalten.

Mehr als wirtschaftlicher Erfolg: Die Chance, mit deiner Arbeit einen echten Beitrag zu Nachhaltigkeit und sozialem Engagement zu leisten.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

Our Member Experience Managers are the go-to problem solvers, momentum drivers, and experience creators for our members. You’re the connector and the person everyone knows. jobs.title: Operations Manager - Education & Student Services
jobs.description:
Operations Manager - Education & Student Services

London School of Excellence is looking for a highly organised and proactive Operations Manager to oversee our day-to-day education operations.

The successful candidate will manage staff activity, student communication, application progress, university correspondence, operational reporting and partnership development.

This is a hands-on management role for someone who can keep multiple teams and processes organised, ensure tasks are completed on time, and provide management with clear visibility of ongoing operations.

Tasks

  • Manage and monitor day-to-day staff activities, attendance, punctuality and overall performance.
  • Allocate daily and weekly tasks and ensure work is completed on time.
  • Conduct brief team check-ins and review staff weekly reports.
  • Monitor whether students, agents and universities are being contacted and followed up by the responsible team.
  • Oversee student enquiries, application progress, outstanding documents and pending actions.
  • Ensure applications are properly assigned, updated and progressed without unnecessary delay.
  • Monitor university communication, application follow-ups, offers, conditions and outstanding matters.
  • Assign or coordinate important operational emails and internal communication.
  • Support and monitor new university/education partnership activities, including follow-ups and meetings.
  • Ensure staff correctly update the CRM and internal systems.
  • Monitor overdue tasks, inactive cases and unresolved issues.
  • Identify blockers, coordinate with the relevant team members and make sure problems are resolved quickly.
  • Act as the main communication point across teams to keep workflows moving smoothly.
  • Maintain visibility of staff workload, task status and operational priorities.
  • Prepare a weekly operations report for senior management.
  • Escalate serious staff, application, university or operational issues when required.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in operations, education, student recruitment, admissions, office management or a similar role.
  • Experience managing or supervising a team.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Confident communicating professionally with students, staff, universities and external partners.
  • Strong follow-up skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Comfortable using CRM systems, email, spreadsheets and other digital tools.
  • Ability to identify problems and take ownership of resolving them.
  • Professional and confident telephone manner.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Ability to work independently and take responsibility for day-to-day operations.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, based on experience
  • Opportunity to take ownership of a growing education operation.
  • Work directly with senior management.
  • Professional development and career progression opportunities.
  • Exposure to university partnerships, student recruitment and education operations.
  • Supportive and collaborative working environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to improving internal systems and processes.

If you are an organised, responsible and proactive professional who enjoys managing people, solving operational problems and keeping teams on track, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your CV together with a short introduction outlining your relevant experience.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
Account Executive, UK & Ireland Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Account Executive, UK & Ireland Manufacturing

The role is remote located in the UK

Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

About You:

  • You are driven by new business development and have a proven track record of managing the full sales cycle for SaaS solutions in the manufacturing industry.
  • You are commercially-minded and thrive in environments that are scaling quickly, and you're excited to contribute to building new processes.
  • You have a customer-centric approach, with a genuine desire to listen to and learn from clients and partners.
  • You possess a hands-on mentality and are adept at managing large, complex projects.

What skills do I need?

  • 5-7+ years of experience in an Account Executive role, selling complex software solutions into the manufacturing sector.
  • Deep understanding of the UK manufacturing industry is highly desirable.
  • A consistent track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills
  • Trained/certified in value-selling sales methodologies 
  • A positive, can-do attitude is a key quality to succeed on the Tulip team
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.com is a plus; organize / report on all sales productivity on a consistent basis
  • Ability to quickly learn Salesforce, Outreach, Zoominfo, Linkedin Sales Navigator
  • Experience in cross functional collaborations and contributions to building highly functional commercial teams

Key Responsibilities:

  • Break into and drive large, complex deals through lead to close. Experience navigating large company procurement processes.
  • Drive account strategies and account plans to execute a sales process and win deals within assigned accounts.
  • Manage multiple customer opportunities with multiple partners at once while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.
  • Build accurate forecasting and an operational cadence with management
  • Drive referenceable customer satisfaction in your accounts
  • Expertly demonstrate Tulip technology to end users and execute opportunities with channel partners.
  • Have passion for technology and speak fluently about current trends related to SaaS, PaaS, IoT, and cloud solutions.
  • Develop champions, stakeholder mind-share, and close at the VP/C-level.
  • Be a planner and lead the preparation of client engagements across internal and partner stakeholders to speed deal cycle times. 
  • Leverage and collaborate with internal/external resources as a team player; Professional Services, Pre Sales Engineering, Marketing, Channel Partners, etc.

Key Collaborators:

  • Sales
  • Pre Sales Engineering
  • Customer Success
  • Marketing
  • Professional Services
  • Channel and Alliances

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. 

We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

  • Company equity: Share in the success you help create.
  • Holiday Allowance: Unlimited vacation policy.
  • Learning & Development: A dedicated budget for your professional growth.

We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Please note that we may use AI-based tools to support parts of our hiring process. All data processing is carried out in compliance with local data protection laws, ensuring all personal candidate information is handled securely and ethically.

Nos clients dans les secteurs de la banque et de la finance, nos clients choisissent désormais l'innovation et la technologie pour se transformer. Spécialiste en conseil organisationnel, en amélioration des performances commerciales et en optimisation de l'expérience client grâce à l'informatique et à l'IA, VO2 Finance propose une expertise digitale à la fois technologique, méthodologique et sectorielle – incluant le financement, les marchés de capitaux, les opérations front, middle et back office, les systèmes d'information bancaires et la réglementation.
 
 
CONTEXTE

Au sein de la division Pre-Trade, Sales & Execution de la DSI Marchés de Capitaux d'une grande banque d'investissement (CIB), vous rejoindrez l'équipe en charge du développement des composants cœur de la plateforme de trading électronique.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement Front-Office exigeant de très hautes performances, au contact de systèmes critiques nécessitant le traitement massif d'événements en temps réel et l'intégration de progiciels de marché.

Note : Nous recherchons également un profil plus junior (0 à 3 ans) sur ce même périmètre. Offre disponible ici 

 
 
DESCRIPTIF DE MISSION 

Au sein d'une équipe technique de pointe, vos principales responsabilités s'articulent autour des axes suivants :

  • Conception & Développement C# :

    • Développer les composants de publication, d'enregistrement et de réédition de données internes et externes.

    • Mettre en place des stratégies et des scénarios de simulation pour les rééditeurs de données.

    • Concevoir et optimiser les passerelles externes (connecteurs Horizon, ION MarketWired / OMS).

  • Algorithmes & Fonctionnel :

    • Interagir directement avec les utilisateurs (Traders, Quants, Sales) pour recueillir et traduire leurs besoins métiers.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive – France
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive – France

Build a Territory. Build a Category.

Enterprise sales is changing. AI is reducing layers, raising expectations and increasing individual ownership. The best Enterprise Account Executives don't wait for pipeline; they create it. This isn't a role where you inherit customers or opportunities. You'll build a strategic territory across France, identify your target accounts, develop executive relationships, create pipeline and close complex enterprise deals. If that excites you, we'd like to talk.

Why Sifflet
Every organisation is investing in AI. Few fully trust the data behind it.
Sifflet helps enterprises understand what their data represents, who owns it, how it flows through the business and whether it can be trusted for critical decisions.
As AI adoption accelerates, trusted data is becoming a board-level priority. We're building the control plane that gives enterprises confidence in the data powering their business and AI.

What you'll do

  • Build and own a strategic territory of 40–50 enterprise accounts across France, selecting organisations aligned to our ICP.

  • Develop account strategies based on business priorities, data maturity and organisational context.

  • Generate pipeline through outbound, partnerships, executive networking and market signals.

  • Own complex end-to-end sales cycles (€50K–€1M+ ARR), including multi-year enterprise agreements.

  • Build relationships across technical, operational and executive stakeholders.

  • Partner with AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft, GCP and leading consulting partners to create and accelerate opportunities.

  • Expand successful customers into long-term strategic accounts.



What we're looking for

  • 5–10 years' experience selling B2B SaaS.

  • Proven progression into Enterprise sales with experience closing complex six- and seven-figure opportunities.

  • A track record of creating and converting your own pipeline.

  • Experience navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise buying groups.

  • Comfortable engaging with CDOs, Heads of Data, Data Platform and Analytics leaders.

  • Experience selling into enterprise organisations across Financial Services, Retail, Manufacturing or Technology.

  • Fluent French and English.



You'll thrive here if you...

  • Want ownership rather than entitlement.

  • Enjoy building territories from the ground up.

  • Take a structured, disciplined approach to enterprise sales.

  • Can identify genuine opportunity rather than relying on volume.

  • Build compelling business cases and executive relationships.

  • Are comfortable operating with ambiguity and creating momentum yourself.

  • Are motivated by uncapped earnings and the opportunity to build something meaningful.



This role isn't for you if...

  • You expect SDRs or Marketing to generate enough pipeline to hit quota.

  • You prefer transactional, high-volume sales.

  • You rely heavily on pre-sales or solution engineers to progress opportunities.

  • You need detailed playbooks for every situation.

  • You want an established territory with existing customers to inherit.



What you get

  • Competitive salary and uncapped commission.

  • Meaningful equity in a fast-growing company.

  • Ownership of the French enterprise market.

  • The autonomy to build your own territory and strategy.

  • A focused ICP with the freedom to shape your account portfolio.

  • Close collaboration with leadership and a genuine opportunity to influence our GTM strategy.

  • The chance to work with some of Europe's most data-driven organisations.



If you're looking for a role with abundant inbound leads, large support teams and an established territory, there are plenty of options.

If you want ownership, accountability and the opportunity to build something in one of enterprise software's fastest-growing categories, we'd love to hear from you.
